zh:
<bigger>{<title>{絲克瑪的試煉}}

絲克瑪的試煉會讓你進行一場遠古的考驗。通過這些試煉的人將可獲得豐厚的獎勵。該試煉需要一枚巨靈之幣才能進行。



完成這些試煉可獲得[AscendancyPoints|昇華天賦點數]。



在試煉中受到傷害會影響你的[Honour|榮譽]。失去的榮譽會在試煉之間保留下來。

失去所有榮譽時，試煉便會失敗。但你的角色不會死亡。



<bigger>{<title>{聖物}}

聖物將會影響試煉的各個要素，使其變簡單。你的聖物在不同試煉之間會被保留下來。

<yellow>{當你有正在進行中的試煉時，所選的聖物便無法更換。}



聖物有各種面向，所以請謹慎使用來最大化你的利益。



你可以擊殺試煉中的頭目來解鎖更多聖物欄位。



多餘的聖物可以存放在聖物鎖櫃或你的倉庫頁中。

Then the great fall.
The pain of separation.
We return once more.

en:
We dance in the white, like water,
colliding as many and emerging as one.

detail: missing={} extra={'default': 1}

We wait, still as the dead,
to join the great avalanche.

detail: missing={} extra={'default': 1}

until we must feed upon each other.

and trembled, and shook,
until she was not what she saw.

we bowed in awe and were crushed.

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en: We've added four new Warcry skills and reworked three existing ones. Warcries now scale based on the power of nearby enemies rather than the quantity. Many Warcries also <italic>{exert} your attacks, increasing their power for a number of attacks.
zh: 我們新增 4 個新戰吼技能，並重製 3 個現有的戰吼。戰吼的效能現在根據附近敵人的強度，而不是數量。部分戰吼同時會加強 你的攻擊，短時間內增加它們的強度。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en: <italic>{Path of Exile: Heist} also introduces over 25 new Unique Items, 12 new Divination Cards, a visual revamp to some skill effects and much more.
zh: 流亡黯道：劫盜同盟同時也引進 25 件新傳奇道具、12 張命運卡和部分技能效果翻新等，等著流亡者探尋唷。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en: <italic>{When the Elder was sealed, entities far beyond the borders of the Atlas of Worlds took note and turned their attention in our direction. The first such visitor is an entity called The Maven. She is hungry to witness your fight for survival against the Atlas' most dangerous foes. Accept her challenge to put your talents and mortality to the test. Should you prove worthy, she will offer you a taste of her vast power.}
zh: 釋界在場時擊殺 3 個地圖頭目，你將可獲得前往她領域的邀請，在那她將要求你同時擊敗這 3 名頭目。展現你的實力後，她會跟你下戰帖：同時挑戰 4 名頭目、接著 5、6 最終 10 名頭目。只有完成後，你才能挑戰新的輿圖巔峰頭目：釋界。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en: Eleven new maps and challenging boss encounters have been added to the Atlas. These include unforgiving new locations such as the <italic>{Dry Sea, Forking River, Frozen Cabins} and <italic>{Grave Trough}.
zh:
<italic>{血肉扭曲的碑塔現在正聳立於瓦爾克拉斯的各處。它們的來源和目的未知，它們似乎渴望鮮血和死亡，它們也願意給予能夠餵養它們的人豐厚的獎勵。}

邪靈祭祀是個戰鬥的聯盟，會讓你在祭祀環中，同時對抗祭祀神壇神秘之力的怪物和不斷增強的怪物波。一個地區中，連續進行祭祀儀式將會越來越困難，但也會獲得更好的獎勵。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en:
<italic>{Twisted spires of flesh, blood and sinew now stand scattered across Wraeclast's landscape. Their origins and purposes unknown, they seemingly have a hunger for blood and death and are willing to richly reward those who can sate it.}

Ritual is a combat league that pits you against both the arcane powers of the Ritual Altar and escalating waves of monsters, enclosed within a Ritual Circle. Each successive Ritual in an area is harder and offers better rewards.
zh: 祭祀期間你所擊殺的怪物，將會是你獲得貢禮，可以用來購買各種誘人的物品和獎勵。眾多祭祀獎勵中，有個新的祭祀基礎類型，有對非常強大的固定詞綴，但帶有副作用。你可以消耗部分貢禮來重骰獎勵，或是暫緩所選之物至之後的祭祀事件。

detail: missing={} extra={'italic': 1}
en: Harvest has returned. Instead of having to plant and manage your own Sacred Grove, you will discover portals to established gardens with multiple sets of harvests ready to go. From each pair of options, carefully weigh the encounter difficulty against the crafting outcomes before making a choice. If you can slay the monsters that spawn, you'll be rewarded with Lifeforce that can be used to greatly improve your items.
zh: <italic>{《輿圖謎音》}中，從第 6 張開始會掉落劫盜契約書。盜賊在完成劫盜任務後會快速升級他們的技能、盜賊之印掉落更多和在任務可取得時，下個走私者的祕寶就會掉落任務契約書給你。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Ultimatum}, you must undertake the trials of Chaos and choose whether to risk it all for ultimate power.

Our April expansion contains the Ultimatum challenge league, eight new Skill and Support Gems, improvements to Vaal Skills, an overhaul to past league reward systems, dozens of new items, and much more. We've also just released a new trailer and gameplay showcase for Path of Exile 2.
zh: 古瓦爾文明建立於獻祭上。他們了解為了獲得強大的權力，必須承擔巨大的風險。以瓦爾混沌實體為名的試煉大師，尋求願意為追求力量付出巨大犧牲的挑戰者。隨著你存活過他的每個試煉，你是否仍願意賭上一切，來接受他下個最後通牒。

detail: missing={} extra={'%': 1}
en: The Vaal Reliquary Key can drop from anywhere in Path of Exile and opens a portal to the Vaal Reliquary. This ancient vault contains a chest with a special foil version of a Vaal-themed Unique item, dropped with equal weighting. Due to the value and power level of the items contained within, this is the rarest Reliquary Key ever added to Path of Exile.
zh: 我們推出 8 顆新技能和輔助寶石，都是圍繞在鮮血概念上：獻祭生命以獲取力量。這些寶石為貧血流派的角色帶來更多可能性，貧血的門檻也調高至 50%。我們同時平衡了瓦爾技能和增加傷害傳奇敵人所獲的的靈魂量。

detail: missing={'%': 1} extra={}
en: We've introduced eight new Skill and Support gems that are themed around the concept of blood: sacrificing life for power. These gems open up even more possibilities for characters built around staying on low life, the threshold for which has been increased to 50%. We've also rebalanced Vaal Skills and increased the number of souls gained from damaging Unique enemies.
zh: 在《最後通牒》中，我們優化流亡黯道任何遊戲內容掉落更多有價值的物品。我們為核心掉落池新增通貨、秘密販售配方、強大的聯盟限定傳奇 (包含獵首!)、新輿圖基礎物品和讓章節頭目也有農的價值。但這僅是個開始。流亡黯道中幾乎所以獎勵機制也都被優化了。

detail: missing={} extra={'%': 1}
en: Alongside new Blight, Metamorph and Delirium Incubators, we've modernised other Incubator rewards. We have introduced Blight-themed Scarabs and two new Catalysts. Corrupted Blighted Maps can drop the new Tainted Oil which allows anointment of corrupted items. Chests in Blighted Maps now benefit from the map's item quantity value.
zh:
祭祀已成為核心遊戲機制，輿圖有 8% 機會出現，這也是過去聯盟機制新的機率。我們也透過增強阿茲里限定的祭禮束衣基礎道具來優化她的獎勵，和新增限定她掉落的傳奇物品。

同時也削弱目前過於強大的聯盟機制。不再掉落以骰出最佳詞綴機制的魔符，但它們的抹油可以用汙油瓶改變。部分豐收工藝被移除或限制，但現在豐收出現更頻繁，且密園之心事件現在為可交易的地圖碎片。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Expedition}, you will join the Kalguuran expedition, excavate their lost relics and undead using chains of explosives, then barter, deal and gamble these relics with their merchants.

Our July expansion contains the Expedition challenge league, four new NPC traders, nineteen new skill and support gems, new base item types and unique items. We've also made massive balance changes to make Path of Exile more challenging, including a full rework of the flask system. And finally, Path of Exile: Royale makes its long-awaited return!
zh:
卡爾葛正在使用炸藥在整個瓦爾克拉斯挖掘他們祖先的定居點。被他們發現的危險所嚇壞了，他們需要你的戰力協助。你必須有策略地放置一連串炸藥並引爆它們，擊敗復甦的亡靈。戰術規劃至關重要，因為你必須決定在挖掘中優先考慮什麼，仔細平衡你的誘因和能力。

可以選擇挖掘裝滿珍貴獎勵的寶箱，或者復活卡爾葛探險者的亡者遺體和他們的寶藏。留意散佈在該地點附近的神秘卡爾葛定居遺跡是值得的。引爆後，它們的詞綴會明顯增加探險難度和獎勵。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Sentinel}, ancient constructs have been unearthed across Wraeclast. You will harness the power of these Sentinels to control your level of risk and reward on the battlefield.

Our May expansion contains the Sentinel challenge league, 20 atlas keystone passives, seven uber boss fights, new pinnacle unique items, revamped monster modifiers, game controller support, new quality of life features, a revamped challenge system and much more.
zh:
在這一次聯盟中，流亡者將發掘並蒐集守望並妥善利用它們那強大的力量。在設置之後，它們會在短時間內跟隨著流亡者並賦予敵人力量，大幅地增加敵人的難度與獎勵。

守望分為三個種類。潛行守望會在流亡者遭遇敵人時按順序強化中等數量的敵人。動亂守望則可以在一次快速爆發中強化大量的怪物。而頂尖守望則只強化稀有或傳奇敵人，但效果非常顯著。

detail: missing={'italic': 1} extra={}
en:
<italic>{"They come from another world... a barren world... and they crave our living land and sky. Our Unbroken Sun. They cannot be allowed to gain a foothold here."

- Ailith, First of the Keepers}

The Breachlords are advancing further into the outer world, establishing their ominous constructs across Wraeclast. To stop their conquest, Ailith founded the Order of the Keepers of the Flame. Harness the power of the Flame from Ailith and destroy the Breach infestations once and for all.
zh:
「他們來自另一個世界……一個貧瘠的世界……他們渴求我們這片充滿生命的土地與天空——我們那永不熄滅的太陽。他們絕不能在此立足。」
—初始看守者．艾里絲
裂痕領主的勢力再度蔓延，他們邪異的造物正逐步侵入瓦爾克拉斯。為了阻止這場侵略，艾里絲創立了「黯焰看守者教團」，這個神聖的僧侶組織誓言守護生者之界。運用「黯焰」的淨化之力，徹底摧毀裂痕的侵蝕，終結那步步逼近的黑暗。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 你的
en:
You swore, sinew and soul, to serve God and the Order of the Templar. For years you built a life upon Faith, only to smite it asunder with one sinful blow. 
 
And is that not the greatest folly of all? To lose Faith when it's all you have left?
 
You were once the chosen of God. A Templar. You are now the chosen of Wraeclast. An exile.
zh:
你誓死支持並且奉獻靈魂來服侍偉大的神，以及聖堂武僧的紀律。多年來你的生活都建立在信仰上，但罪孽只輕輕一碰，你堅守的信仰就已經四分五裂、蕩然無存。

這不是天大的笑話嗎？失去了信仰你將一無所有。

你曾經被神選召為聖堂武僧。現在瓦爾克拉斯指名你為流亡者。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 回復
en: An item type that sits in the flask slots and is used to gain some effect on the player character, such as restoring life or mana, or gaining a temporary buff. Flasks are refilled by slaying monsters, or returning to a Town or Hideout.
zh: 放置於藥水欄位的道具，不同的藥水在使用後能獲得不同的效果。擊殺、返回城鎮、藏身處皆可回復藥水的充能。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 回復
en:
Other magic mods can enhance the amount of life or mana a flask restores, or the duration it lasts, or the number of times it can be used. Some also provide extra utilities, such as removing curses or ailments. 

Carefully selecting your flasks and which mods they have is just as important as selecting which weapon to wield or passive skills to take. If ever you are struggling to survive, take a look at your flasks and see if improvements can be made. They are often a cheap and effective place to start solving character build problems.
zh:
有些魔法詞綴可以加強回復的總血量或魔力、或持續時間、或可使用的次數。有的也會提供額外的功能，像是移除詛咒或異常狀態。

謹慎的選擇你的藥劑和它們擁有詞綴，就跟選擇使用的武器或天賦樹點法一樣的重要。若你活得很辛苦，你可以確認你的藥劑還有沒有進不的空間。它們通常是省錢且有效率改善流派問題的第一步。

en: The virtuous are rewarded - in death, if not in life.
zh: 你的美德將獲得獎勵 - 即使不是在生前，也會在死後。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 你的
en:
To extend your life as long as possible

zh:

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 的生
en: A life without risk is no life at all.
zh: 沒有風險的生活根本就不是生活。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 你的
en:
The Order was your clan in life, Agnar, Beastmaster, but the First Ones call
back their favoured son. The gift of their Visions will pass to another.
zh:
野獸專家艾格納，教團過去是你的家族，但初始者喚回
他們最喜愛的兒子。他們幻視的天賦將會轉移至其它人。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 的生
en:
Qianga of the Stars, Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers, go now, and
let your half-dreamt life be troubled by nightmares of achromic hunger no more.
zh:
眾星琴嘉，封印之刃的救贖者給我們的盟友了腐朽的守望者，走吧，
讓你半夢想的生活成為天堂並且不再受到飢餓的噩夢所困擾。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Shadow's Assassin, Saboteur and Trickster Ascendancy classes, we've created the Ambush, Blade Trap and Voltaxic Burst skill gems. Ambush is a new Blink skill which teleports you to an enemy, blinds them and exerts your next one-handed melee attack. When you use Blade Trap, you throw out a mechanical device with two copies of your weapon attached. These blades spin rapidly in a circle a set number of times, dealing damage to anything they pass through. Voltaxic Burst grants a buff which counts down to zero, at which point it detonates, sending out a damaging lightning and chaos explosion. Enemies slain by this explosion will also explode dealing lightning and chaos damage based on a portion of their life.
zh: 圍繞著女巫的秘術家、元素史和死靈師昇華職業，我們新創了禁忌儀式、凜冬之眼和召喚奪魂鐮技能寶石。禁忌儀式會發射一個會爆炸的混沌投射物至目標區域，並同時對你造成傷害。凜冬之眼是個大型投射物，在飛行時會以螺旋形式發射一連串冰冷投射物。召喚奪魂鐮是新的終極召喚物，它以你其它的召喚物為食(就是字面上的意思)。它會對敵人造成流血並可以指揮它攻擊指定的位置。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 傷害
en:
The Warden of Eaves can teach you to become a Warden of the Maji, a powerful class that takes advantage of wilderness knowledge. Wardens of the Maji can coat their weapons with Tinctures, granting them special bonuses. For example, the Ironwood Tincture always stuns enemies on full life and the Oakbranch Tincture is a great finisher for bosses.

A Warden of the Maji has many other wilderness abilities such as Barkskin, which causes Bark to grow all over your body, increasing armour. As you take damage, the Bark temporarily falls off, increasing your evasion.
zh:
邊界守衛可以教導你成為聖賢守護者，這是一個利用野外知識的強大職業。聖賢守護者可以用萃取物塗抹武器，賦予它們特殊的加成。例如，鐵木萃取物可以讓敵人滿血時使其暈眩，而橡樹萃取物則是對頭目的絕佳選擇。

聖賢守護者還擁有許多其他的野外技能，例如木質外膚，它會使樹皮長在你的全身，提高護甲。當你受到傷害時，木質將暫時脫落，增加你的閃避能力。

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 你的
en:
We are adding more than a dozen Quality of Life features based on requests from our community. The Heist Rogues will now automatically begin at maximum level and your Atlas Passive Tree, as well as the regular Passive Skill Tree, will now be instantly refundable with Gold. Level up all of your gems with one click and you can now identify all items in your inventory at once,
with no Scrolls of Wisdom!
zh: 《黯焰看守者》帶來十餘項社群期盼已久的便利性更新，讓冒險體驗更加流暢。「劫盜同盟」成員現在將自動以最高等級開始。「輿圖天賦樹」與一般「天賦樹」皆可使用「黃金」即時重置。一鍵升級你的所有寶石，以及一次鑑定所有背包內的未鑑定物品且不需要知識卷軸！

detail: Life: 应为 生命 此处 你的
en:
This expansion introduces another round of Quality of Life features. You will now be able to favourite trades on the currency exchange, hover over your Asynchronous trade item sale history, and more.

In addition, we've added over 20+ landmark rooms throughout the Campaign, so keep an eye out for new and unexpected rooms, side passages, chests, and encounters as you progress through Wraeclast!
zh:
本次擴充內容帶來了新一輪的遊戲體驗優化。你現在可以在「通貨交易所」中將交易設為最愛、將滑鼠懸停以查看你的非同步交易物品販售歷史紀錄，以及更多其他的便利功能。

此外，我們在劇情章節中新增了 20 多個地標房間，所以在探索瓦爾克拉斯時，請留意那些意想不到的全新房間、側道、寶箱與遭遇！

detail: Mana: 应为 魔力 此处 你的
en:
Expedition is Path of Exile's 30th release since Closed Beta. In almost every update, we provide new ways to improve your characters, more effective skills to use, and ways to craft better and more powerful items. The power level of end-game Path of Exile characters has increased tenfold since Launch. From this expansion onwards, we are working to restore some of the challenge that Path of Exile is known for.

In addition to a substantial Flask Rework, we're reducing the power level of pure-damage support gems, making triggered skills cost mana, tweaking the most powerful movement skills and making the enemies in Path of Exile's first act much more dangerous. Our work to improve the level of challenge in Path of Exile will continue across subsequent expansions.
zh: 我們大幅重製流亡黯道的藥劑系統，目的是減少藥劑帶給玩家永久的強度水準，並促進深思熟慮藥劑的選擇，以激發遊戲的互動。 新的滴注石可以讓你調整你的藥劑，以便它們可以在特定條件下觸發。 點燃石讓你的功能型藥劑提供加成效果，代價是在它們啟動時無法獲得充能。我們還重新設計了許多藥劑並引進新的黃金和金剛藥劑。

detail: Mana: 应为 魔力 此处 藥劑
en:
We're introducing two new specialised stash tabs which allow you to store up to 500 Gems or Flasks respectively. The introduction of these stash tabs also allows players to set affinities for these items on any other stash tabs that will hold them.

The Gem Tab lets you filter between Red, Green, Blue and White gems. You can also select whether these are sorted by criteria such as current gem level, required level or quality. The Flask Tab lets you filter between Life, Mana, Hybrid, Utility and Unique flasks. You can also select whether these are sorted by item level, base type or quality.
zh: 我們介紹兩個新的特殊倉庫頁，非別可以讓你存放超過 500 個寶石和藥劑。這些倉庫頁資訊也可以讓玩家設定物品相容性，讓它們存放於其他倉庫頁中。

detail: Mana: 应为 魔力 此处 你的
en:
In this expansion, we are adding a new set of Exceptional Skill Gems called Pacts that you can get from Beyond bosses and Lycia in the Forbidden Sanctum. Make a bargain with a powerful Beyond Demon to empower your Spells at the cost of afflicting yourself.

In addition we've added a new reservation skill for spellcasters using staves called Mana-infused Staff, as well as several new Transfigured Skill Gems.
zh:
我們將於此版本加入一組全新且獨特的卓越技能寶石，稱為誓約，你可以透過擊敗超越頭目以及禁忌聖域中的利希亞來獲得它們。與強大的超越惡魔進行交易，以自身承受苦難為代價，來大幅強化你的法術。

此外，我們還為使用長杖的施法者加入了一個全新的保留技能魔能長杖，同時也新增了數個全新的變異技能寶石。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en:
In Path of Exile, all of your skills (other than your default attack) come from items called 'skill gems'. Skill gems must be socketed into your equipped weapons and armour in order for you to be able to use the skill they grant.

Support gems work very similarly to skill gems, except they don't grant you a skill by themselves. Instead, support gems can augment the skill gems they are linked to. Not all skill and support gems work together; You can't use a 'Melee Physical Damage Support' with a spell, for example.

You may find red, green or blue sockets on items. If you socket a gem with a matching colour into a red, green or blue socket, then that socketed gem gets a bonus +10% to quality.
zh:
在流亡黯道中，你的所有技能（除了預設攻擊）都是來自於稱作「技能寶石」的物品。技能寶石必須鑲嵌在你已裝備的武器和護甲插槽中，才能使用其賦予的技能。

輔助寶石的運作方式與技能寶石非常相似，但它們本身無法賦予你技能。相反地，輔助寶石可以強化與其連結的技能寶石。並非所有技能寶石和輔助寶石都能搭配使用；舉例來說，你無法將「近戰物理傷害輔助」用於法術上。

你可能會在物品上發現紅色、綠色或藍色的插槽。如果你將顏色相符的寶石鑲嵌在紅色、綠色或藍色的插槽中，該寶石將獲得額外 +10% 品質加成。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en:
You can't kill monsters if you're dead, so you should also carefully consider your defences. Most characters will want some armour, energy shield or evasion, or some combination of the three. Sources of life and increases to it are a great way to extend your lifespan, but you'll also want to seek out ways to mitigate the damage before it ever touches your life pool. 

Fire damage, such as the fire from a cannibal's thrown torch, can be mitigated by sources of 'Fire Resistance'. Merveil's spells deal cold damage, so 'Cold Resistance' is very useful against her. If a certain spell or attack deals significantly more damage to you than anything else, it might be of an element that you don't have much resistance to. If you're ever unsure where you spend your next passive point, it's almost always worth investing in a relevant defence.
zh:
不論你再怎麼厲害，死了一切都是浮雲。在提升角色能力的同時，你也可以多多研究你的防禦手段。大多角色選擇使用護甲、能量護盾、閃避、或者混搭。同時基礎生命和增加生命相關的來源也非常受歡迎，但最有效的方式就是在傷害還沒碰到你的生命池前就已經被減免緩和了。

火焰傷害，可以透過「火焰抗性」來減免。莫薇爾的法術造成冰冷傷害，所以「冰冷抗性」對付她非常有效。如果遊戲中突然發現某些技能對你的角色造成特別多傷害，可能是因為你對應的抗性過低。如果你不確定接下來的天賦該往何處發展，防禦手段幾乎都是不錯的選擇。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en:
Jewels are items that have mods just like your weapons and armour. However, instead of being equipped, they are socketed in the passive skill tree.

Jewels only work when they're socketed in a jewel socket that has been allocated with a passive point. If they are in an unallocated socket, the jewel won't do anything.
zh: 珠寶和你的武器和裝備一樣擁有詞綴。然而它們無法直接裝備，必須透過天賦樹上的插槽才能夠獲得珠寶的效果。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en:
Just like other items, jewels can be normal, magic, rare or unique. They can be modified with currencies like other items, though unlike your weapons and armour, a rare jewel can only have up to four mods. 

Cluster jewels are a type of jewel that can only be socketed in the outer rim of your passive tree. These come in 3 sizes, small, medium and large, and allow you to expand your passive tree with new passive nodes, notables and even more jewel sockets!

Some unique jewels, such as Efficient Training above, can modify the passive skills around them:
zh:
就像其他物品一樣，珠寶也有分魔法、稀有、傳奇稀有度。珠寶也能夠受到通貨物品的改造，但不像一般的武器和裝備，珠寶最多只能擁有 4 條詞綴。

星團珠寶也是珠寶的一種，只能放置於你天賦樹外圍的插槽。星團珠寶有 3 個大小：小、中、大，並且可以讓你擴張你的天賦樹，有額外的天賦點、核心天賦和更多珠寶插槽！

部分傳奇珠寶，像是充分訓練，可以調整他們附近的天賦：

en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Heist}, you will hire skilled thieves to help you pull off risky Heists. Steal valuable artifacts to fund and train your crew as you plan towards the execution of a Grand Heist.

Our September expansion contains the Heist challenge league, nine new Skills and Support Gems, revamps of Curses, Steel Skills, and some Spells. Grand Heists offer exclusive new rewards such as Weapon and Body Armour Enchantments, Heist Trinkets, Alternate-quality Gems and Replica Unique Items.
zh:
在<italic>{流亡黯道：劫盜同盟}中，你將雇用技術高超的盜賊來幫你完成危險的劫盜任務。當你執行劫盜之星計畫時，盜取有價值的工藝品來資助和培訓你的隊員。

我們 9 月的大改版包含劫盜挑戰聯盟、9 個新技能和補助寶石、詛咒、鋼之技能和部分法術翻新。劫盜之星會給予專屬獎勵，像是武器、胸甲附魔、劫盜飾品、替代品質寶石和複製傳奇道具。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en: Inspired by the Duelist's Champion, Gladiator and Slayer Ascendancy classes, we've created the Defiance Banner and Shield Crush skill gems and the Behead support gem. Defiance Banner is a new defensive tool that can be used to increase your armour and evasion while reducing the critical strike chance of nearby enemies. Shield Crush swipes your shield towards your enemies and sends out forceful waves of damage based on the stats of your shield. The Behead Support can only support Strike skills and is basically like a mini-Headhunter. When your supported Strike slays a rare enemy, you'll steal one of its modifiers at random for 20 seconds.
zh: 受到遊俠的俠客、追獵者和銳眼昇華職業啟發，我們引進了暴風雷雨和爆裂物技能寶石，和專注砲塔輔助。暴風雷雨發射會插入地面的箭矢。這些箭矢會定期發射脈衝造成閃電傷害，並射向附近的箭矢。專注砲塔會讓你的砲塔專注的朝你的目標發射，並只有在你發射時才會行動。爆裂物限定空手並朝目標投擲會爆炸的投射物。你可以消耗紅玉、藍玉和黃玉藥劑充能來增強爆裂物。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en:
The Warden of Eaves can teach you to become a Warden of the Maji, a powerful class that takes advantage of wilderness knowledge. Wardens of the Maji can coat their weapons with Tinctures, granting them special bonuses. For example, the Ironwood Tincture always stuns enemies on full life and the Oakbranch Tincture is a great finisher for bosses.

A Warden of the Maji has many other wilderness abilities such as Barkskin, which causes Bark to grow all over your body, increasing armour. As you take damage, the Bark temporarily falls off, increasing your evasion.
zh:
邊界守衛可以教導你成為聖賢守護者，這是一個利用野外知識的強大職業。聖賢守護者可以用萃取物塗抹武器，賦予它們特殊的加成。例如，鐵木萃取物可以讓敵人滿血時使其暈眩，而橡樹萃取物則是對頭目的絕佳選擇。

聖賢守護者還擁有許多其他的野外技能，例如木質外膚，它會使樹皮長在你的全身，提高護甲。當你受到傷害時，木質將暫時脫落，增加你的閃避能力。

detail: Armour: 应为 外觀 此处 你的
en:
We're releasing our annual Core Supporter Packs alongside the release of Path of Exile: Affliction. There are five packs available that each include their full value in points, exclusive armour sets and additional cosmetic microtransactions that visually interact with gameplay in new ways. The higher packs also include physical merchandise and a new opportunity to leave your mark on Path of Exile.

Path of Exile: Affliction will launch on December 8 (PST) for PC and Mac, and on December 13 for Xbox and PlayStation.
zh:
隨著《流亡黯道：禁咒荒林》登場，我們將同步推出年度核心贊助包，分為五個等級，內含其各自價格的等值黯幣、限定護甲套裝組，以及會在遊玩過程產生互動特效的商城物品。較高等級的贊助包還包含實體周邊，更有新的機會讓你在《流亡黯道》的世界留下屬於你的足跡。

《流亡黯道：禁咒荒林》將於 12 月 8 日在 PC 和 Mac 上推出，並於 12 月 13 日在 Xbox 和 PlayStation 上推出（太平洋標準時間）。

en: Path of Exile: Delve includes ten powerful new or completely reworked skills, centered around two character archetypes: the Guardian and the Pathfinder. detail: Damage: 应为 傷害 此处 增加
en: Inspired by the Marauder's Juggernaut, Berserker and Chieftain Ascendancy classes, we've created the Boneshatter and Rage Vortex skill gems and the Earthbreaker support gem. Boneshatter strikes enemies with a forceful blow. If this attack stuns an enemy, it releases a powerful shockwave with area based on the stun's duration. As you use Boneshatter more, it deals more and more damage to enemies and to yourself. Rage Vortex consumes your Rage to unleash a whirling vortex that rapidly hits enemies within its range. The Earthbreaker Support summons an Ancestral Totem that uses any supported Slam Skill.
zh: 受到決鬥者的冠軍、衛士和處刑者昇華職業啟發，我們推出反抗之旗和重盾粉碎，和斬首輔助寶石。反抗之旗是新的防禦手段，可以增加你的護甲和閃避，並同時減少附近敵人的暴擊率。重盾粉碎會朝前方敵人揮舞你的盾牌並根據你盾牌的數值發出強力的衝擊波。斬首只能輔助打擊技能，並像小型的獵首。當你的被輔助打擊技能擊殺稀有敵人時，你會偷取它其中一條詞綴 20 秒。

detail: Attack: 应为 攻擊 此处 傷害
en:
You can't kill monsters if you're dead, so you should also carefully consider your defences. Most characters will want some armour, energy shield or evasion, or some combination of the three. Sources of life and increases to it are a great way to extend your lifespan, but you'll also want to seek out ways to mitigate the damage before it ever touches your life pool. 

Fire damage, such as the fire from a cannibal's thrown torch, can be mitigated by sources of 'Fire Resistance'. Merveil's spells deal cold damage, so 'Cold Resistance' is very useful against her. If a certain spell or attack deals significantly more damage to you than anything else, it might be of an element that you don't have much resistance to. If you're ever unsure where you spend your next passive point, it's almost always worth investing in a relevant defence.
zh:
不論你再怎麼厲害，死了一切都是浮雲。在提升角色能力的同時，你也可以多多研究你的防禦手段。大多角色選擇使用護甲、能量護盾、閃避、或者混搭。同時基礎生命和增加生命相關的來源也非常受歡迎，但最有效的方式就是在傷害還沒碰到你的生命池前就已經被減免緩和了。

火焰傷害，可以透過「火焰抗性」來減免。莫薇爾的法術造成冰冷傷害，所以「冰冷抗性」對付她非常有效。如果遊戲中突然發現某些技能對你的角色造成特別多傷害，可能是因為你對應的抗性過低。如果你不確定接下來的天賦該往何處發展，防禦手段幾乎都是不錯的選擇。

detail: Spell: 应为 法術 此处 技能
en: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when you die. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.
zh: 當你死亡時觸發所有輔助寶石。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。瓦爾技能、引導時施放技能和保留技能無法被觸發。

detail: Spell: 应为 法術 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Templar's Hierophant, Guardian and Inquisitor Ascendancy classes, we've created the Manabond, Absolution and Battlemage's Cry Skills. Manabond creates a rune that explodes, dealing more damage or having more area of effect, based on the current state of your mana pool. When Absolution's damaging shockwave kills an enemy, it creates a Sentinel of Absolution which also casts its own shockwaves. Battlemage's Cry taunts nearby enemies and exerts subsequent attacks, causing them to trigger a linked spell on your next melee hit.
zh:
死境探險是流亡黯道封測以來第 30 次大改版。在幾乎每一次改版中，我們都會提供新的方法來改善角色，更有效的技能使用和工藝更好、更強大物品的方法。自發布以來，流亡黯道終局的角色強度水平增加了十倍。從這次改版開始，我們正在努力恢復流亡黯道眾所皆知挑戰難度。

除了大量的藥劑重製外，我們還降低了純傷害型輔助寶石的強度，使觸發型技能消耗魔力，調整最強的位移技能並使流亡黯道第一章的敵人更加危險。提高流亡黯道難度的工作將在後續改版中繼續進行。

detail: Spell: 应为 法術 此处 技能
en: (Hunger of Ghorr gains a Stage every time you cast a different Empowered Spell with Pact of Ghorr, up to a maximum of 3 Stages. Stages are reset back to 0 when you recast Pact of Ghorr )
zh: （每當你使用戈沃誓約施放不同的強化技能時，便會獲得一層戈沃之飢渴，最多 3 層。當你重新施放戈沃誓約時，層數將重置為 0）

detail: Minion: 应为 召喚 此处 攻擊
en: A stationary object that can cast spells or attack remotely. Unlike traps and mines, totems have a life pool akin to minions. Unlike minions, totems can't typically move around, and are unaffected by minion modifiers.
zh: 無法行動的物件，能夠遠端施放法術或攻擊。和陷阱和地雷不同的是，圖騰有自己的生命值，並且不會受到怪物詞綴的影響。

detail: Minion: 应为 召喚 此处 傷害
en: Themed around the Witch's Occultist, Elementalist and Necromancer Ascendancy classes, we've created the Forbidden Rite, Eye of Winter and Summon Reaper skill gems. Forbidden Rite fires a barrage of exploding chaos projectiles at nearby enemies while also inflicting damage on you. The Eye of Winter is a large projectile that fires out a torrent of cold projectiles in a spiral formation as it travels. Summon Reaper is a new minion that feeds off your other minions (literally). It inflicts bleed on enemies and can be commanded to attack specific locations.
zh: 受到聖堂武僧的聖宗、守護者和判官昇華職業啟發，新創了魔能束縛、赦免和戰法戰吼技能。魔能束縛會製造一個爆炸的符文，根據你魔力池的狀況來決定造成更多傷害或是更多範圍效果。當赦免的衝擊波擊殺敵人，他會製造赦免哨兵，哨兵也會使用它們的衝擊波。戰法戰吼會嘲諷附近的敵人並竭盡接下來的攻擊，使你接下來的近戰擊中觸發相連的法術。

en:
The passive skill tree also contains jewel sockets. An allocated jewel socket can hold a jewel, but won't grant any sort of benefit by itself. Jewels cannot interact with Masteries.

The edges of the passive skill tree are also home to Large jewel sockets, these can hold Cluster jewels as well as regular jewels.

天賦樹中包含了珠寶插槽。配置到珠寶插槽時，可以裝備一個珠寶，但裝備珠寶前不會獲得任何效果。珠寶不會與專精互動。

天賦樹邊緣同時也是巨型珠寶插槽的所在，這些插槽可以放置星團珠寶或一般珠寶。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: Passives that specifically say they grant 'more' or 'less' of something are the exceptions to the above rule. These are applied after all of the increases, acting like multipliers. Unlike passives which increase something, passives which provide 'more' or 'less' of something never add together and instead each apply their multiplicative effect separately. These terms appear on Keystones in the passive skill tree, but are most commonly seen on support gems.
zh: 如果天賦中有特別說明獲得「更多」或「更少」什麼的話，則不是用此規則。這將會於加總全部的增加詞綴後再套用此詞綴，像是加成的效果。不像增加詞綴會先加總，「更多」或「更少」詞綴會用相乘的方式計算。在輔助寶石上很常見此方式。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
Jewels are items that have mods just like your weapons and armour. However, instead of being equipped, they are socketed in the passive skill tree.

Jewels only work when they're socketed in a jewel socket that has been allocated with a passive point. If they are in an unallocated socket, the jewel won't do anything.
zh: 珠寶和你的武器和裝備一樣擁有詞綴。然而它們無法直接裝備，必須透過天賦樹上的插槽才能夠獲得珠寶的效果。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
Although any class in Path of Exile can eventually reach any passive skill on the passive skill tree, each class has their own distinct set of Ascendancy classes. A Witch can, for example, eventually become an Elementalist, but a Templar cannot. 
 
You can unlock your Ascendancy class by completing the Labyrinth and using the Altar of Ascendancy in the final room. Higher-tier Labyrinths then grant two more Ascendancy points when you reach the Altar of Ascendancy, for a total of 8 points.
zh:
雖然流亡黯道中任何職業都可以隨心所欲的擴展天賦，但每個職業都擁有屬於自己的昇華職業。舉例來說，女巫將能夠昇華成為「元素使」但聖堂武僧卻不行。

在第一次完成帝王迷宮後點擊昇華盤即可選擇解鎖昇華職業，後續更高階的帝王迷宮中，每次完成都會獎勵你額外 2 點昇華點數，每隻角色最多可以取得 8 點昇華點數。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
Abyss jewels are special jewels with their own pool of mods. Unlike ordinary jewels, Abyss jewels have multiple tiers of many of their mods, as well as level requirements. They can also be socketed in a new type of item socket -- the Abyssal socket -- as well as in the passive skill tree. Abyssal sockets can be found on the Stygian Vise belt base type.

At higher levels, some Abyss events will lead into subterranean areas with special bosses. The most dangerous of these bosses can drop special Abyss league-exclusive unique items with Abyssal sockets.
zh:
深淵珠寶是個很特別的珠寶，有屬於它們自己的詞綴。不像其他一般的珠寶，深淵珠寶的詞綴有許多各種階級，等擊需求也是。它們可以被放置在新的插槽種類--深淵插槽--，也可以放置於天賦樹中。深淵插槽可以在新道具：冥河腰帶上發現。

在高等地區的深淵，有機會引導至地下區域，裡面有特別的頭目。這些危險的頭目會掉落深淵聯盟限定的傳奇道具，而這些道具也都有深淵插槽。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: From each of the five Legions, it's possible to earn a special unique Jewel that can be socketed into your Passive Skill Tree. Each of the five jewels modifies nearby passive skills in different ways, providing completely new character customisation options if you are skilled enough to acquire one.
zh: 五個軍閥中，都有機會從他們手中獲得特殊的傳奇珠寶，這個珠寶可以放置於天賦樹中。這五個珠寶，每個都會以不同方式調整他們附近的天賦，若你夠有經驗可以獲得一個，將會帶給你全新的角色制定體驗。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: Among other treasures, the Blight yields Oils which Sister Cassia can use to anoint your jewellery. Combine two Oils to enchant a Ring with a potent tower modifier. Combine three Oils to enchant your Amulet with any Notable Passive Skill from the Skill Tree. The twelve Oils vary considerably in rarity, with each combination of them granting a different result.
zh: 眾多寶物中，凋落會產出油瓶，修女卡西亞可以用來塗抹於你的飾品。合成兩種油附魔於戒指上可獲得增強守塔的詞綴。合成三種油附魔於你的項鍊，會從天賦樹上獲得任一核心天賦。這十二種油瓶相當稀有，每種組合都可以產出不同的結果。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
Extend your passive skill tree by placing a Cluster Jewel in one of its outermost sockets. With craftable mods that improve the passives generated, add one of 280 new notables, or even graft additional sockets for deeper nesting, Cluster Jewels let you grow your own passive tree.

Dropping from any monster in the Delirium League, these new Jewels are one of the most significant improvements to build customisation since the introduction of Ascendancy Classes.
zh:
你可以透過在最外圍天賦的珠寶插槽放置星團珠寶來延展你的天賦樹。這些星團珠寶有著可工藝的詞綴，可以優化生成的天賦、從 280 個新天賦附加一個、甚至可以連接更深層的額外插槽，星團珠寶讓你可以栽種屬於你的天賦樹。

星團珠寶會從譫妄聯盟的怪物掉落，這些珠寶是自昇華天賦以來，可大幅改良客製化流派的選項之一。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: The Passive Skill Tree has received many improvements including better support for some mechanics (for example, Two-handed Weapons or Rage) with both numeric buffs and entirely new clusters of passives. In addition, there are many new notable and keystones passives, which include both fan-favourites from Timeless Jewels and even some entirely new ones.
zh: 天賦樹進行許多優化，包含用更多的增益效果和全新的天賦叢來更好的輔助部分機制 (像是雙手武器或盛怒)。除此之外，還有許多新強力和關鍵天賦，包含了玩家喜愛的永恆珠寶上的天賦，當中也有全新的天賦。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 使用
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Expedition}, you will join the Kalguuran expedition, excavate their lost relics and undead using chains of explosives, then barter, deal and gamble these relics with their merchants.

Our July expansion contains the Expedition challenge league, four new NPC traders, nineteen new skill and support gems, new base item types and unique items. We've also made massive balance changes to make Path of Exile more challenging, including a full rework of the flask system. And finally, Path of Exile: Royale makes its long-awaited return!
zh:
卡爾葛正在使用炸藥在整個瓦爾克拉斯挖掘他們祖先的定居點。被他們發現的危險所嚇壞了，他們需要你的戰力協助。你必須有策略地放置一連串炸藥並引爆它們，擊敗復甦的亡靈。戰術規劃至關重要，因為你必須決定在挖掘中優先考慮什麼，仔細平衡你的誘因和能力。

可以選擇挖掘裝滿珍貴獎勵的寶箱，或者復活卡爾葛探險者的亡者遺體和他們的寶藏。留意散佈在該地點附近的神秘卡爾葛定居遺跡是值得的。引爆後，它們的詞綴會明顯增加探險難度和獎勵。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
The Scourge expansion includes a rework of Path of Exile's iconic passive skill tree. Despite these large changes, the tree is intended to still feel familiar to existing players. We have rebalanced all passive skills, consolidated their power around their primary function, and moved many niche stats to a new system: <italic>{Passive Skill Masteries.}

When you allocate the first Notable passive skill in a cluster, a Mastery appears. Allocating a skill point to this Mastery allows you to pick from a list of advanced stats that match the theme of the cluster. This new system both makes the tree more understandable and gives you more freedom for how you plan your passive skills. We have also rebalanced a few keystone passives, changed the locations of some and added six new keystones to the tree.
zh:
轉世災魘改版包含了流亡黯道標誌性的天賦樹重製。儘管有這些巨大的變化，但現有玩家仍然會對這棵樹有熟悉感。我們重新平衡了所有天賦，圍繞其主要功能鞏固了它們的力量，並將許利基數據移至新系統：<italic>{天賦專精}。

當你配置天賦群中的第一個強力天賦時，會出現專精。為該專精配置一個天賦點可以讓你從與天賦群主題相匹的高階數據清單中進行選擇。這個新系統讓天賦樹更容易理解，也使你計劃天賦時有更自由的選擇。我們還重新平衡一些關鍵天賦，改變了一些的位置，並在天賦樹中新增了六個新關鍵天賦。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Siege of the Atlas}, two new Eldritch Horrors threaten to consume the Atlas of Worlds. Join Commander Kirac's militia and defend the Atlas and Wraeclast itself against these celestial foes.

This large endgame expansion contains new Atlas systems, pinnacle bosses, one gigantic Atlas passive skill tree, Eldritch implicit endgame crafting, new unique items, the Archnemesis Challenge league and much more.
zh:
在<italic>{《流亡黯道：輿圖圍城》}中，兩個新的異能恐懼威脅著要消滅異界輿圖。加入指揮官基拉克的民兵隊，來保衛輿圖和瓦爾克拉斯，免於這些星際敵人。

這次大型終局改版包含新的輿圖機制、巔峰頭目、一棵大型輿圖天賦樹、異能固定詞綴工藝、新傳奇物品和宿敵挑戰聯盟等。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: Say goodbye to regional Atlas Passive Trees and hello to one gigantic Atlas-wide Passive Tree with over 600 skills to specialise in. Every map as well as various Atlas quests you complete will earn you an Atlas skill point. In addition to the best skills from the regional trees, we have created many completely new ones that let you choose your own level of risk and reward for Atlas content.
zh: 跟地區型的輿圖天賦樹說再見，並歡迎這棵超大全輿圖的天賦樹，超過 600 點天賦。你完成的每張地圖和輿圖任務都可以獲得 1 點輿圖天賦點。除了有地區型天賦樹上最好的天賦外，我們還新創許多天賦，供你選擇輿圖內容中的風險等級和獎勵。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: In an iconically Path of Exile way, your weapons can now be imbued with powerful Passive Skill Trees of their own. Encounters at Crucible Forges grant you experience that lets you uncover the tree on a weapon and gradually progress through its skills. You can only allocate one skill from each tier, so choose your path through each Crucible Passive Tree carefully. If you're lucky, you'll find certain skills that, when allocated, are worth valuable currency or unique items when sold to a vendor.
zh: 最具有流亡黯道象徵的天賦樹，現在可以灌注到你的武器上。熔火鍛造中的事件有機會讓你體驗，在你的武器上發現武器的天賦樹，並逐步掌握它的技巧。你只能從每個階級中配置一個天賦，所以請謹慎地選擇熔火天賦樹上的路線。若你夠幸運，你配置特定天賦時會發現當販售給商人時，會獲得稀有通貨或傳奇物品。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: Crucible's endgame takes place in The Forge of the Titans, a dangerous area harbouring an ancient power: the ability to melt a weapon down, merging its Crucible Passive Tree with that of another weapon. This process produces unpredictable results, incorporating elements of each tree as well as random upgrades, downgrades and changes. Through careful use of the Forge, it's possible to craft some incredibly powerful skill trees on your weapons.
zh: 熔火的最終試煉發生於泰坦族的熔爐，那是個蘊含著古老之力的危險地區：可以熔化武器、將它的熔火天賦樹和另一件武器的融合在一起。這個鍛造過程會產出無法預期的結果，包含每顆天賦樹的元素和隨機升級、降級和變動。小心謹慎的使用熔爐，會有機會在你的武器上工藝出相當強大的天賦樹。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: Among other endgame improvements, Path of Exile: Crucible introduces Atlas Gateways - nodes on the Atlas Passive Tree that allow instant travel between two locations. There are three pairs of gateways, each allowing travel from the left side of the tree to the right side or vice versa. Each end of the gateway consumes one Atlas Skill Point to allocate, but using them makes it possible to easily engage with all the content that you want to play, regardless of which side of the tree it's on.
zh: 在眾多《流亡黯道：熔火冥獄》的終局優化中推出－輿圖大門：輿圖天賦樹上的天賦點，相連兩個不同的位置。總共有 3 組輿圖大門，可以讓你從左側跳往右側，反之亦然。每個大門的點都需要消耗 1 輿圖天賦點來配置，但使用這些大門可以讓你更容易實現你想玩的內容，無論它在天賦樹上的哪一側。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en: In this expansion, unlock access to multiple Atlas Passive Skill Trees which can be used to enhance your Endgame experience to its maximum potential. Earn up to two extra trees by progressing through the Atlas and choose your desired playstyle for each Endgame Map.
zh: 在這次改版中解鎖多個輿圖天賦樹，全面提升你的終局體驗。你最多可透過輿圖進展獲得兩組額外天賦樹，為每張終局地圖隨心打造遊玩風格。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
Scarabs which can be used to enhance your Endgame Maps have been overhauled. A myriad of new options have been added, giving ways to push the challenges and rewards of Endgame Maps to new heights.

The Atlas Passive Skill Tree has also been improved to give increased access to content in more ways than ever before.
zh: 聖甲蟲可用於強化已昇華的終局地圖。新增吞噬選項，讓你把終局地圖的挑戰和獎勵推向新高。輿圖天賦樹也有所改進，讓你以更多前所未有的方式查閱內容。

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
We are adding more than a dozen Quality of Life features based on requests from our community. The Heist Rogues will now automatically begin at maximum level and your Atlas Passive Tree, as well as the regular Passive Skill Tree, will now be instantly refundable with Gold. Level up all of your gems with one click and you can now identify all items in your inventory at once,
with no Scrolls of Wisdom!
zh: 《黯焰看守者》帶來十餘項社群期盼已久的便利性更新，讓冒險體驗更加流暢。「劫盜同盟」成員現在將自動以最高等級開始。「輿圖天賦樹」與一般「天賦樹」皆可使用「黃金」即時重置。一鍵升級你的所有寶石，以及一次鑑定所有背包內的未鑑定物品且不需要知識卷軸！

detail: Skill: 应为 技能 此处 天賦
en:
The structure of the Atlas has also changed: you will now begin at the centre of the Atlas, with each corner housing one of the four Voidstones, and all content accessed from your map device now exists physically on the Atlas. You will have to explore the Atlas in order to discover where all the feared Atlas entities reside.

Many of these Atlas entities now offer Atlas Skill points, allowing you to get more than ever before. Not all Unique Maps are required to obtain all of your Atlas Skill Points - now only requiring completing any 10 to get the maximum number.
zh:
輿圖的結構也發生了改變：現在你將從輿圖的中心開始，四個角落分別存放著四顆虛空石，所有透過地圖裝置進入的內容，現在都實體存在於輿圖上。你必須親自探索輿圖，才能發現那些令人畏懼的輿圖存在棲息於何處。

其中許多輿圖存在現在將提供輿圖天賦點，讓你獲得比以往更多的點數。你不再需要完成所有的傳奇地圖來取得所有的輿圖天賦點——現在只需完成任意 10 張，即可獲得最大點數上限。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Ranger's Raider, Pathfinder and Deadeye Ascendancy classes, we've created the Storm Rain and Explosive Concoction skill gems and the Focused Ballista support gem. Storm Rain fires arrows that stick into the ground. These arrows periodically pulse with lightning damage that arcs to nearby arrows. Focused Ballista causes your Ballistas to focus fire on your target and only fire when you do. Explosive Concoction must be used unarmed and throws an explosive projectile at your target. You can enhance this explosion by consuming charges from Ruby, Sapphire or Topaz flasks.
zh: 受到暗影刺客的刺客、破壞者和詐欺師昇華職業啟發，推出了伏擊、刀鋒陷阱和魔痕爆發技能寶石。伏擊是個新的閃現技能，可以將你傳送至敵人並致盲他們，且會竭盡你下個單手近戰攻擊。當你使用刀鋒陷阱時，你會投擲一個機械裝置，上面附有你武器的兩個複製體。 這些刀片會快速旋轉一定次數，對穿過的任何物體造成傷害。魔痕爆發給予一個倒計時到零的增益效果，在你附近觸發一道閃電傷害，其中一部分傷害轉化為混沌傷害。被你的魔痕爆發殺死的敵人也會爆炸，根據他們的最大生命在他們附近造成混沌傷害。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 造成
en: Theopolis wasn't built in a day, and neither will Kingsmarch, but many hands make light work. Head to the town and hire skilled workers who will aid you in mining, smelting, disenchanting, farming and other jobs needed in Kingsmarch. You'll notice each person has their specialties, and a wage cost. It'll be up to you to hire and fire as you please. Over the course of the league you'll be searching for your perfect employees for each job. Once you have them, you'll have to keep them paid, safe, and alive.
zh: 費歐普羅斯不是一天造成的，金司馬區也不例外。但只要有足夠人手，建造的過程就會縮短許多。玩家可前往城鎮雇用協助你開採、冶煉、破幻、耕種等其他金司馬區必要工作的工人。你會發現，每個工人都有各自的專精和工資成本，而雇用和解雇的事就由你來決定。在整個聯盟的遊戲過程中，你將要尋找最適合各個工作的工人。雇用他們之後，你就得支付他們薪資，並保護他們的安危。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a targeted location which then explodes, damaging nearby foes.
zh: 朝目標位置釋放一顆向前飛射的火球，接著爆炸，對附近敵人造成傷害。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
zh: 投擲一個陷阱，觸發時會射出一個寒冰投射物，在接觸到敵人或到達目標區域時會爆炸，造成範圍傷害和製造會造成冰冷持續傷害的冰緩區域。此冰緩區域會蔓延至附近的敵人，直到它的持續時間結束。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en: Creates a wave of divine fire dealing damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.
zh: 產生一道直線聖焰波，並產生奉獻地面，對一個區域造成傷害。接著一道更大的震波向外擴散，對奉獻地面上尚未遭擊中的敵人造成傷害。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en: Fire a rapidly decelerating arrow that converts part of the physical damage it deals to chaos. When it comes to a stop, it will trigger Chaotic Burst.
zh: 發射一支急速加快的箭矢，且造成物理傷害的一部分轉換為混沌傷害。當它停止時，將會觸發混沌爆發。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and slows their movement speed. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.
zh: 朝空中發射數個箭矢並在目標區域如雨般降下，對擊中的敵人造成傷害並於它們降下的地方製造黴孢。每個黴孢對附近敵人造成混沌持續傷害並減緩它們的移動速度。短暫時間過後，黴孢會爆炸造成範圍傷害。

zh: 對天空射出一支箭矢，降落於目標位置。箭矢對落地區域附近造成範圍傷害，並釋放出一道炎浪，對敵人造成燃燒減益效果。

zh: 發射一組三支電之箭矢，這些箭矢會快速消散，在射出經過一小段時間即消失。發射出的箭矢具有強勁力量，會產生閃電爆發，對你前方扇形區域內的敵人造成傷害。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en:
Summon a Mirage Archer above your head when Galvanic Arrow hits an enemy. This Mirage Archer will fire Galvanic Arrows at nearby enemies until it disappears.

This gem has many uses. Use it to attack enemies while you're moving, to attack enemies you're not facing, or to deal more damage.
zh:
當你的電流箭矢擊中敵人後在你的頭上召喚幻影射手。幻影射手在消失之前都會自動朝著附近的敵人發射電流箭矢。 
\ 這個輔助寶石有許多用途。例用幻影射手在你移動中持續攻擊敵人、同時攻擊不同方向的敵人或對同一個敵人造成更多傷害。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害
en:
Let loose a flurry of arrows with the Barrage support gem. With each Galvanic Arrow fired, lightning will burst from your bow.This will stop your arrows from firing in a cone, and instead make them fire in sequence.

This gem is invaluable for unleashing a flurry of attacks on strong enemies, like bosses.
Be careful using it in dangerous dangerous situations. You cannot move while firing, so you cannot escape dangerous enemies.
zh:
增加電流箭矢的元素傷害，用更高的傷害痛擊敵人。
 這個輔助寶石不會增加電流箭矢所造成的物理傷害，但會增加其所造成的閃電傷害。 

 這個輔助寶石和物理轉閃電輔助有非常良好的搭配，因為物理轉閃電輔助可以將電流箭矢所造成的傷害完全轉為閃電傷害。

detail: Fire: 应为 火焰 此处 傷害

Fire a flurry of Kinetic Bolts in quick succession, damaging enemies consistently over a wide area. 

You cannot stop or move while firing. This gem improves damage but be careful not to get stuck taking damage while monsters attack you.
zh:
快速連續發射力量穿引，持續對範圍內敵人造成傷害。

發射時你無法停止或移動。此寶石可以增強傷害，但請小心不要在使用時被怪物攻擊。

detail: Cold: 应为 冰冷 此处 傷害
en: Themed around the Witch's Occultist, Elementalist and Necromancer Ascendancy classes, we've created the Forbidden Rite, Eye of Winter and Summon Reaper skill gems. Forbidden Rite fires a barrage of exploding chaos projectiles at nearby enemies while also inflicting damage on you. The Eye of Winter is a large projectile that fires out a torrent of cold projectiles in a spiral formation as it travels. Summon Reaper is a new minion that feeds off your other minions (literally). It inflicts bleed on enemies and can be commanded to attack specific locations.
zh: 受到聖堂武僧的聖宗、守護者和判官昇華職業啟發，新創了魔能束縛、赦免和戰法戰吼技能。魔能束縛會製造一個爆炸的符文，根據你魔力池的狀況來決定造成更多傷害或是更多範圍效果。當赦免的衝擊波擊殺敵人，他會製造赦免哨兵，哨兵也會使用它們的衝擊波。戰法戰吼會嘲諷附近的敵人並竭盡接下來的攻擊，使你接下來的近戰擊中觸發相連的法術。

detail: Lightning: 应为 閃電 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Shadow's Assassin, Saboteur and Trickster Ascendancy classes, we've created the Ambush, Blade Trap and Voltaxic Burst skill gems. Ambush is a new Blink skill which teleports you to an enemy, blinds them and exerts your next one-handed melee attack. When you use Blade Trap, you throw out a mechanical device with two copies of your weapon attached. These blades spin rapidly in a circle a set number of times, dealing damage to anything they pass through. Voltaxic Burst grants a buff which counts down to zero, at which point it detonates, sending out a damaging lightning and chaos explosion. Enemies slain by this explosion will also explode dealing lightning and chaos damage based on a portion of their life.
zh: 圍繞著女巫的秘術家、元素史和死靈師昇華職業，我們新創了禁忌儀式、凜冬之眼和召喚奪魂鐮技能寶石。禁忌儀式會發射一個會爆炸的混沌投射物至目標區域，並同時對你造成傷害。凜冬之眼是個大型投射物，在飛行時會以螺旋形式發射一連串冰冷投射物。召喚奪魂鐮是新的終極召喚物，它以你其它的召喚物為食(就是字面上的意思)。它會對敵人造成流血並可以指揮它攻擊指定的位置。

en: Inspired by the Duelist's Champion, Gladiator and Slayer Ascendancy classes, we've created the Defiance Banner and Shield Crush skill gems and the Behead support gem. Defiance Banner is a new defensive tool that can be used to increase your armour and evasion while reducing the critical strike chance of nearby enemies. Shield Crush swipes your shield towards your enemies and sends out forceful waves of damage based on the stats of your shield. The Behead Support can only support Strike skills and is basically like a mini-Headhunter. When your supported Strike slays a rare enemy, you'll steal one of its modifiers at random for 20 seconds.
zh: 受到遊俠的俠客、追獵者和銳眼昇華職業啟發，我們引進了暴風雷雨和爆裂物技能寶石，和專注砲塔輔助。暴風雷雨發射會插入地面的箭矢。這些箭矢會定期發射脈衝造成閃電傷害，並射向附近的箭矢。專注砲塔會讓你的砲塔專注的朝你的目標發射，並只有在你發射時才會行動。爆裂物限定空手並朝目標投擲會爆炸的投射物。你可以消耗紅玉、藍玉和黃玉藥劑充能來增強爆裂物。

Boneshatter strikes enemies with a forceful blow. If this attack stuns an enemy, it releases a powerful shockwave with area based on the stun's duration. As you use Boneshatter more, it deals more and more damage to enemies and to yourself. Rage Vortex consumes your Rage to unleash a whirling vortex that rapidly hits enemies within its range. The Earthbreaker Support summons an Ancestral Totem that uses any supported Slam Skill.

en: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.
zh: 一定要同時輔助可擊中敵人的技能和咒術技能。技能擊中時會施放咒術。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。

detail: Curse: 应为 詛咒 此处 光環

detail: Curse: 应为 詛咒 此处 敵人
en: Abyss has been significantly reworked in Curse of the Allflame. Abyssal cracks are now open, spilling their energy into the surrounding area, influencing nearby enemies. Slay them to draw the attention of Abyssal hordes that emerge from the depths to tear you apart.  There is now much more visceral feedback in the moment-to-moment gameplay of Abyss with audio and visual cues drawing you along. You can gain Abyssal Jewels and Stygian Vises through the Abyss, and this mechanic has also received a complete refresh of Scarabs and passive tree investment.
zh:
深淵機制在《亡焰咒海》中迎來了重大重製。現在，深淵裂縫處於開啟狀態，其能量會外溢至周圍區域並影響附近的敵人。擊殺這些敵人以引來深淵部族的注意，牠們將從地底深處湧現並企圖將你撕碎。

現在，深淵在即時戰鬥的遊玩體驗上擁有了更具衝擊力的反饋，音效與視覺提示將一路引導著你。你可以從深淵之中獲得深淵珠寶與冥河腰帶，且此機制也對聖甲蟲與異界天賦樹的投資進行了全面的翻新。

detail: Projectile: 应为 投射 此处 傷害
en:
Throw a projectile copy of your weapon at enemies that bounces between them, poisoning them. 

Poison deals chaos damage over time to your enemies based on your chaos and physical damage. You can poison enemies multiple times at once. Requires a Dagger or Claw to use.
zh:
向敵人投擲你武器的複製體，並在敵人間彈跳使他們中毒。

中毒會根據你的混沌和物理傷害對敵人造成混沌持續傷害。你可以使敵人一次中毒多次。限定使用匕首或爪。

detail: Projectile: 应为 投射 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Ranger's Raider, Pathfinder and Deadeye Ascendancy classes, we've created the Storm Rain and Explosive Concoction skill gems and the Focused Ballista support gem. Storm Rain fires arrows that stick into the ground. These arrows periodically pulse with lightning damage that arcs to nearby arrows. Focused Ballista causes your Ballistas to focus fire on your target and only fire when you do. Explosive Concoction must be used unarmed and throws an explosive projectile at your target. You can enhance this explosion by consuming charges from Ruby, Sapphire or Topaz flasks.
zh: 受到暗影刺客的刺客、破壞者和詐欺師昇華職業啟發，推出了伏擊、刀鋒陷阱和魔痕爆發技能寶石。伏擊是個新的閃現技能，可以將你傳送至敵人並致盲他們，且會竭盡你下個單手近戰攻擊。當你使用刀鋒陷阱時，你會投擲一個機械裝置，上面附有你武器的兩個複製體。 這些刀片會快速旋轉一定次數，對穿過的任何物體造成傷害。魔痕爆發給予一個倒計時到零的增益效果，在你附近觸發一道閃電傷害，其中一部分傷害轉化為混沌傷害。被你的魔痕爆發殺死的敵人也會爆炸，根據他們的最大生命在他們附近造成混沌傷害。

detail: Projectile: 应为 投射 此处 傷害
en: Themed around the Witch's Occultist, Elementalist and Necromancer Ascendancy classes, we've created the Forbidden Rite, Eye of Winter and Summon Reaper skill gems. Forbidden Rite fires a barrage of exploding chaos projectiles at nearby enemies while also inflicting damage on you. The Eye of Winter is a large projectile that fires out a torrent of cold projectiles in a spiral formation as it travels. Summon Reaper is a new minion that feeds off your other minions (literally). It inflicts bleed on enemies and can be commanded to attack specific locations.
zh: 受到聖堂武僧的聖宗、守護者和判官昇華職業啟發，新創了魔能束縛、赦免和戰法戰吼技能。魔能束縛會製造一個爆炸的符文，根據你魔力池的狀況來決定造成更多傷害或是更多範圍效果。當赦免的衝擊波擊殺敵人，他會製造赦免哨兵，哨兵也會使用它們的衝擊波。戰法戰吼會嘲諷附近的敵人並竭盡接下來的攻擊，使你接下來的近戰擊中觸發相連的法術。

zh: 一定要同時輔助攻擊和法術技能。當攻擊技能擊殺敵人時會觸發法術技能。不能輔助圖騰、陷阱和地雷技能。瓦爾技能、引導時施放技能和保留技能無法被觸發。

detail: Melee: 应为 近戰 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Shadow's Assassin, Saboteur and Trickster Ascendancy classes, we've created the Ambush, Blade Trap and Voltaxic Burst skill gems. Ambush is a new Blink skill which teleports you to an enemy, blinds them and exerts your next one-handed melee attack. When you use Blade Trap, you throw out a mechanical device with two copies of your weapon attached. These blades spin rapidly in a circle a set number of times, dealing damage to anything they pass through. Voltaxic Burst grants a buff which counts down to zero, at which point it detonates, sending out a damaging lightning and chaos explosion. Enemies slain by this explosion will also explode dealing lightning and chaos damage based on a portion of their life.
zh: 圍繞著女巫的秘術家、元素史和死靈師昇華職業，我們新創了禁忌儀式、凜冬之眼和召喚奪魂鐮技能寶石。禁忌儀式會發射一個會爆炸的混沌投射物至目標區域，並同時對你造成傷害。凜冬之眼是個大型投射物，在飛行時會以螺旋形式發射一連串冰冷投射物。召喚奪魂鐮是新的終極召喚物，它以你其它的召喚物為食(就是字面上的意思)。它會對敵人造成流血並可以指揮它攻擊指定的位置。

detail: Melee: 应为 近戰 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Templar's Hierophant, Guardian and Inquisitor Ascendancy classes, we've created the Manabond, Absolution and Battlemage's Cry Skills. Manabond creates a rune that explodes, dealing more damage or having more area of effect, based on the current state of your mana pool. When Absolution's damaging shockwave kills an enemy, it creates a Sentinel of Absolution which also casts its own shockwaves. Battlemage's Cry taunts nearby enemies and exerts subsequent attacks, causing them to trigger a linked spell on your next melee hit.
zh:
死境探險是流亡黯道封測以來第 30 次大改版。在幾乎每一次改版中，我們都會提供新的方法來改善角色，更有效的技能使用和工藝更好、更強大物品的方法。自發布以來，流亡黯道終局的角色強度水平增加了十倍。從這次改版開始，我們正在努力恢復流亡黯道眾所皆知挑戰難度。

除了大量的藥劑重製外，我們還降低了純傷害型輔助寶石的強度，使觸發型技能消耗魔力，調整最強的位移技能並使流亡黯道第一章的敵人更加危險。提高流亡黯道難度的工作將在後續改版中繼續進行。

A single Orb creates a challenging encounter, but up to five can be applied to a map for ultimate difficulty and rewards.
zh: 譫妄玉可以使用在終局的地圖上，來掌控你所遭遇的譫妄事件。在譫妄玉的影響下，你會立即進入譫妄且持續整張地圖。一顆譫妄玉就可以製造高難度的事件，但一次至多可以使用五顆在地圖上，來體驗究極的譫妄難度並獲得豐富的獎勵。

detail: Rarity: 应为 稀有 此处 物品
en:
Divination cards are items found throughout Path of Exile that can be turned in for a reward. Different divination cards reward you with different things, including currency, specific item basetypes, other divination cards, and even unique items that can't normally be found. There are even some items that can only be obtained by collecting the right cards.
 
Every divination card was designed with the help of our supporters, though the rarity and drop locations were determined by Path of Exile developers.

Some divination cards can only be found in certain locations or from certain enemies, so pay attention to where you are when you find them. If there's one you really like, you might consider visiting that area frequently to find more.
zh:
你將能夠在瓦爾克拉斯各地找到命運卡，不同命運卡給予不同的獎勵，從通貨、特定基底物品、更多的命運卡、甚至是平常無法取得的傳奇道具。

某些命運卡只會在特定的地圖或者特定的怪物身上掉落，多多留意它們的來源，若有中意的命運卡，不妨時常去該區域打轉。

detail: Rarity: 应为 稀有 此处 物品
en:
We've overhauled rare and magic monsters throughout Path of Exile, revisited the difficulty and rewards of Archnemesis mods, revamped Beyond and have made large changes to Harvest.

Past league content now spawns a more consistent and less overwhelming quantity of rare monsters. Defeating monsters with multiple Archnemesis mods is now far more rewarding. Powerful monster mods now convert your item drops in a way that stacks with rewards from other mods and player item rarity or quantity bonuses. The Beyond league has been updated with the monsters and bosses from Scourge, and has been given a balance revamp. Harvest crafting has been overhauled to use a tradeable currency, and can now be done in your own time, at the horticrafting station in your hideout.
zh:
我們對流亡黯道的平衡性進行了許多調整，包括對詐欺師昇華和召喚物品的大改。我們重新設計詐欺師昇華，重點是建立與主題相符的防禦和操縱速度的方法。查看在此截圖的新昇華天賦。

有了大量新的出裝機會，召喚物流派現在與其他流派一樣因找到好物品而獲益。有幾種新的以召喚物為中心的基礎類型，玩家可以找到並工藝它們以提高召喚物的傷害和生存能力。

祭祀已成為核心遊戲機制，輿圖有 8% 機會出現，這也是過去聯盟機制新的機率。我們也透過增強阿茲里限定的祭禮束衣基礎道具來優化她的獎勵，和新增限定她掉落的傳奇物品。

detail: Quality: 应为 品質 此处 寶石
en:
We're introducing two new specialised stash tabs which allow you to store up to 500 Gems or Flasks respectively. The introduction of these stash tabs also allows players to set affinities for these items on any other stash tabs that will hold them.

The Gem Tab lets you filter between Red, Green, Blue and White gems. You can also select whether these are sorted by criteria such as current gem level, required level or quality. The Flask Tab lets you filter between Life, Mana, Hybrid, Utility and Unique flasks. You can also select whether these are sorted by item level, base type or quality.
zh: 我們介紹兩個新的特殊倉庫頁，非別可以讓你存放超過 500 個寶石和藥劑。這些倉庫頁資訊也可以讓玩家設定物品相容性，讓它們存放於其他倉庫頁中。

detail: Quality: 应为 品質 此处 增加
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Sentinel}, ancient constructs have been unearthed across Wraeclast. You will harness the power of these Sentinels to control your level of risk and reward on the battlefield.

Our May expansion contains the Sentinel challenge league, 20 atlas keystone passives, seven uber boss fights, new pinnacle unique items, revamped monster modifiers, game controller support, new quality of life features, a revamped challenge system and much more.
zh:
在這一次聯盟中，流亡者將發掘並蒐集守望並妥善利用它們那強大的力量。在設置之後，它們會在短時間內跟隨著流亡者並賦予敵人力量，大幅地增加敵人的難度與獎勵。

守望分為三個種類。潛行守望會在流亡者遭遇敵人時按順序強化中等數量的敵人。動亂守望則可以在一次快速爆發中強化大量的怪物。而頂尖守望則只強化稀有或傳奇敵人，但效果非常顯著。

detail: Quality: 应为 品質 此处 增加
en: The Affliction Challenge League has many different types of rewards. Monsters you fight throughout Wraeclast can be affected by the Wisps you have brought back from the Viridian Wildwood, dramatically increasing the quality and quantity of items they drop. As you progress through the league, you will earn a Wildwood Ascendancy Class and the Charms, Corpses or Tinctures that it utilises. The Mists hide many additional secret rewards that you will discover as you explore. Path of Exile: Affliction also contains over 15 new unique items.
zh: 禁咒聯盟有許多不同類型的獎勵。你在瓦爾克拉斯戰鬥的怪物，會受到你從翠綠荒林帶回的妖精影響，大幅增加它們掉落物品的質量和數量。隨著你在聯盟中的進度，你將獲得一個荒林昇華職業，以及它所使用的咒語、屍體或萃取物。在你探索的過程中，迷霧中也隱藏著許多額外的秘密獎勵。《流亡黯道：禁咒荒林》還有超過 15 個新傳奇物品。

detail: Quality: 应为 品質 此处 寶石
en:
In Path of Exile: Keepers of the Flame you will continue the story of Breach, an iconic league from Path of Exile's past, and assist a mysterious monastic order in defending Wraeclast from the Breachlords.

Our October expansion introduces new, twisted ways to empower your character, alongside new crafting mechanics and gems, Bloodline Ascendancies, three new uber pinnacle bosses, a plethora of quality of life features, and the long-anticipated Asynchronous Trade system.
zh:
在《流亡黯道：黯焰看守者》中，你將重返《裂痕》的混亂之中——一個古老的僧侶教團正奮力守護瓦爾克拉斯，抵抗裂痕領主的再臨。

這次十月的擴充內容延續了《流亡黯道》最具代表性的賽季之一，帶來全新的角色強化方式、嶄新的打造機制與技能寶石、「血裔昇華」以及三位全新「巔峰首領」的挑戰。同時，眾多便利性更新與萬眾矚目的「非同步交易系統」也將正式登場，重塑流亡者之間的交流方式。

detail: Quality: 应为 品質 此处 寶石
en:
We are adding more than a dozen Quality of Life features based on requests from our community. The Heist Rogues will now automatically begin at maximum level and your Atlas Passive Tree, as well as the regular Passive Skill Tree, will now be instantly refundable with Gold. Level up all of your gems with one click and you can now identify all items in your inventory at once,
with no Scrolls of Wisdom!
zh: 《黯焰看守者》帶來十餘項社群期盼已久的便利性更新，讓冒險體驗更加流暢。「劫盜同盟」成員現在將自動以最高等級開始。「輿圖天賦樹」與一般「天賦樹」皆可使用「黃金」即時重置。一鍵升級你的所有寶石，以及一次鑑定所有背包內的未鑑定物品且不需要知識卷軸！

detail: Quality: 应为 品質 此处 寶石
en:
In Path of Exile: Mirage you will take on a rogue sect of the Faridun as they sap the energies of captured Djinn for nefarious ends, and help a legendary Maraketh Sekhema put an end to an ancient war once and for all.

Our new expansion introduces a new Challenge League, a variety of new and reworked Skill and Support Gems, significant Endgame changes and a plethora of Quality of Life features.
zh:
在《流亡黯道：遠古蜃景》中，你將對抗一支法里登的叛賊，他們出於某些邪惡的目的俘獲巨靈並抽取的能量。你將協助一位傳奇的馬拉克斯絲克瑪，徹底結束一場遠古戰爭。

我們的全新擴充內容帶來了全新的挑戰聯盟、各種全新與重製的技能寶石和輔助寶石、重大的終局內容改動，以及大量的遊戲體驗優化。

detail: Trap: 应为 陷阱 此处 傷害
en:
May refer to one of several things: Frenzy, Endurance, and Power Charges, which can be gained from items or skills, and which grant significant boosts to damage and attack/cast speed, damage reduction, and critical strike chance respectively. 

Charge may also refer to Flask charges, which determine how many uses a flask has. Flask charges are regained primarily by slaying monsters.

Charge can also reference the number of uses a skill has, such as some trap skills or Vaal skills that can store enough souls for multiple uses.
zh:
一般意旨能透過物品、技能、天賦效果獲得的「狂怒球」、「耐力球」、「暴擊球」。它們能夠提供給你大量的能力強化，像是：傷害、攻擊/施放速度、傷害減免、暴擊率。

充能同時也可能意旨藥水的充能，主要用於判斷該藥水能夠使用的次數。回復藥水充能的主要方法為擊殺怪物。

最後，充能也可能意指某個技能在短時間內能夠使用的次數。

detail: Trap: 应为 陷阱 此处 傷害
en: Inspired by the Shadow's Assassin, Saboteur and Trickster Ascendancy classes, we've created the Ambush, Blade Trap and Voltaxic Burst skill gems. Ambush is a new Blink skill which teleports you to an enemy, blinds them and exerts your next one-handed melee attack. When you use Blade Trap, you throw out a mechanical device with two copies of your weapon attached. These blades spin rapidly in a circle a set number of times, dealing damage to anything they pass through. Voltaxic Burst grants a buff which counts down to zero, at which point it detonates, sending out a damaging lightning and chaos explosion. Enemies slain by this explosion will also explode dealing lightning and chaos damage based on a portion of their life.
zh: 圍繞著女巫的秘術家、元素史和死靈師昇華職業，我們新創了禁忌儀式、凜冬之眼和召喚奪魂鐮技能寶石。禁忌儀式會發射一個會爆炸的混沌投射物至目標區域，並同時對你造成傷害。凜冬之眼是個大型投射物，在飛行時會以螺旋形式發射一連串冰冷投射物。召喚奪魂鐮是新的終極召喚物，它以你其它的召喚物為食(就是字面上的意思)。它會對敵人造成流血並可以指揮它攻擊指定的位置。

detail: Mine: 应为 礦坑 此处 碧藍礦
en:
With the Azurite you find in the mine you can craft and upgrade flares and dynamite.

Flares are portable light sources that can be thrown to specific locations and last for a short while. You won't get very far through the mine by just throwing flares -- you need Crawler's help for that -- but you can use them to explore areas near your pre-lit paths for valuable treasures.

Dynamite won't provide any light, but can be used to harm enemies and open up new paths. You'll encounter Fractured Walls throughout the mine that can be destroyed with a well-placed stick of dynamite.  Both of these items can be upgraded at the Generator, improving their effectiveness as well as the amount of each that you can carry. It's worth carrying a few on your character when you want to go treasure-hunting in the dark.
zh:
在礦脈中找到的碧藍礦可以用來工藝和升級閃光和炸藥。

閃光是可攜帶式光源，可以投擲至特定地區並持續一小段時間。你無法使用閃光就探險至礦脈很遠的地區 -- 你需要潛伏號的幫忙 -- 但你可以使用它們來探索先前已經被點亮的道路附近來找到稀有的寶藏。

炸藥不會提供任何光線，但可以用來傷害敵人和開啟新道路。你在礦脈會遇到壁痕之牆，炸藥位置放的好的話可以摧毀它。以上兩個物品都可以在製電機升級，改善他們的效能和你可以攜帶的數量。當你想要當暗影尋寶獵人時，攜帶一些在角色身上是相當划算的喔。

en: We often received feedback that Mines, though strong, felt clunky to use. In Blight, we have completely reworked Mine mechanics from the ground up. Thrown to a location rather than placed at your feet, Mines now deploy more quickly and detonate in sequence. Mine skills now also reward you for detonating long sequences. New and reworked Mine Support Gems, as well as the mobile Skitterbots, provide new avenues for explosive power. All these additions are further enhanced by changes to the Passive Skill Tree and the Saboteur Ascendancy Class.

Adds flat lightning damage to Stormblast Mine's explosions.

Dealing more damage also increases the strength of Shock, causing more damage taken on Shocked enemies.

增加風爆地雷爆破傷害的閃電傷害。

造成更多傷害同時也增強感電的力量，使感電的敵人承受更多傷害。

detail: Mine: 应为 礦坑 此处 地雷

detail: Mine: 应为 礦坑 此处 地雷
en:
Causes Stormblast mine explosions to deal more damage.

Dealing more damage also increases the strength of Shock, causing more damage taken on Shocked enemies.
zh:
是風爆地雷的爆炸造成更多傷害。

造成更多傷害同時也增強感電的力量，使感電的敵人承受更多傷害。

detail: Mine: 应为 礦坑 此处 地雷
en:
Allows Stormblast mine's lightning damage to penetrate lightning resistance. This allows for more consistent damage against lightning-resistant enemies, such as Bosses, Rares, and Magic enemies.

Monsters show if they are resistant to damage in their mods. Hover over monsters to see their mods.
zh:
使風爆地雷的閃電傷害穿透閃電抗性。對抗有閃電抗性的敵人，像是頭目、稀有和魔法怪物時，有更多的傷害。

怪物若有抗性會於他們的詞綴中顯示。滑鼠移至怪物上方即可看見他們的詞綴。

detail: Mine: 应为 礦坑 此处 地雷
en: Increased Area of Effect makes your Stormblast Mine explosions wider, so they can hit more enemies. It also means Stormblast Mine can cause more enemies to take increased damage before exploding.
zh: 增加你的範圍效果，使風爆地雷的爆炸範圍更大，使它們可以擊中更多敵人。這也表示風爆地雷在爆炸前可以使更多敵人增加承受傷害。

detail: 注→註
en: "Wandering proboscises and clicking mandibles, the swarming masses birthed from darkness destined to forever plague the known world. They bring poverty and painful poisons, those who devour the harvest."
zh: "有力的下顎，蟲群居在黑暗中且眾注定要永遠困擾著個世界。牠們吞噬收成的作物帶來貧難和痛苦的毒素。"

detail: 注→註
en: Poor sailor boy. Doomed to go wherever the winds blow him.
zh: 可憐的水手男孩。注定要隨風而行。

detail: 伙→夥
en: Piety's home away from home. Let's see if the sick witch is in.
zh: 這裡是派蒂的地盤。看看那個失心瘋的傢伙在裡面作什麼。

detail: 祢→禰
en: I beg of you, God. Help me to lead this world back into the light.
zh: 神啊，我祈求祢，協助我讓這片土地重見光明！

detail: 祢→禰 祢→禰
en: Your humble servant thanks you, my God.
zh: 神啊，祢謙卑的僕人感謝祢。

detail: 祢→禰
en: Your trust is the only reward I need, my Lord of Light.
zh: 帶來光明的神啊，我只奢求祢的信任！

detail: 蹒→蹣
en: This land is teetering on the brink of Cataclysm.
zh: 這片土地正蹒跚在大地震的邊緣。

detail: 伙→夥
en: Women like you give the rest of us a bad name.
zh: 就是像妳這樣的傢伙敗壞我們女人的名聲。

detail: 伙→夥
en: Men like you shall not inherit Wraeclast.
zh: 像你這樣的傢伙不配居住在瓦爾克拉斯。

detail: 欲→慾
en: This was the only way to satisfy your appetite, Doedre.
zh: 我想這是滿足你無止盡食欲的唯一方法，德瑞。

detail: 癡→痴
en: Depraved? Demented? No. This is Vinia, desperate to prove she is Piety. A little girl playing dress up, using atrocity as a cheap prop.
zh: 墮落？癡呆？ 不，這是薇妮雅，絕望地證明她是派蒂。 一個小女孩打扮，把暴行當作廉價的支柱。

en: So was that the true face of God, Exile? ...No. Just another vainglorious echo of the hollow 'I Am.'
zh: 流亡者，這是真神的面目嗎？…不。只是另一個虛幻的“我是”的迴聲。

en: Piety's 'science' may aid in uncovering the truth of this world. God does have a sense of humor.
zh: 派蒂的“科學”可能有助於揭示這個世界的真相。神確實有幽默感吧。

detail: 注→註
en: Faith and solidarity go hand in hand. Petty rivalries doom even the mightiest warriors.
zh: 信念和團結是相輔相成的。即使是最強大的戰士，小小的對抗也會注定失敗。

detail: 回→迴
en: This is not exactly how I pictured my triumphant return to Oriath.
zh: 這並不是我對凱旋回歸奧瑞亞的想像。

en: Daring dark and dingy spaces, for 'science!'
zh: 為“科學！”，大膽的黑暗和骯髒的空間。

en: This 'Goddess of Lust' better be worth it!
zh: 這個“色慾女神”最好值得！

detail: 象→像
en: Imagine what you two could have accomplished had you worked together. Madness, pure madness.
zh: 想象一下，如果你們兩個合作，你們本可以取得什麼成就。瘋狂，純粹的瘋狂。

detail: 注→註
en: One way or another, this city is doomed.
zh: 無論如何，這座城市注定要毀滅。

detail: 愈→癒
en: There's still a chance these fields can heal... if I can put a stop to this.
zh: 這片土地仍然有機會痊愈...只要我能制止這一切。

detail: 琐→瑣
en: You two could have changed the world. Instead, you let petty jealousies consume you. Pathetic.
zh: 你們兩個本可以改變世界。相反，你們讓琐碎的嫉妒吞噬了你們。可悲。

detail: 霉→黴
en: I must have jinxed myself. Here we go again...
zh: 我一定是觸霉頭了。又來了……

detail: 注→註
en: It seems those who don't learn from their mistakes are doomed to repeat them.
zh: 看來那些無法從錯誤中學到教訓的人，注定會重蹈覆輒下去。

en: Reclaim a cosmetic effect from an item (<<xbox_button_a>> then <<xbox_button_a>> on the item)
zh:
小技巧：
<default>{- 多個關鍵字以空白鍵分隔。僅反白包含所有關鍵字的物品。
搜尋耐火性可找到同時包含「火焰」和「耐性」的物品，例如「附加火焰傷害」和「冰冷抗性」的物品

- 使用半形引號搜尋特定詞組：例如 “火焰抗性”
如此將只顯示包含完整詞組「火焰抗性」的物品。
搜尋多個詞組時以空白鍵分隔：例如 “閃電抗性” “火焰傷害”。

- 可透過稀有度和屬性來搜尋特定物品：魔法 稀有 傳奇 聖杯 塑界者 尊師 已汙染

- 輸入 ilvl:X 即可搜尋指定的物品等級
輸入“等級：2” （包括引號）以找出所有等級 2 和 20~29 的物品。

- 使用 ~ 篩選包含價格的物品。

- 支援正規表示。}

detail: 雇→僱
en:
Hire Recruits for Kingsmarch to perform various Jobs around town.

Recruits have an up front Hire Cost and a Wage, which is how much Treasury Gold they will be paid for each hour they spend working any job.

Recruits can specialise in one or more jobs. Each job speciality will have a Rank, which determines how proficient the recruit is at that job.

Raulf can Reroll the recruits in the window for a Gold fee.
zh:
為金司馬區僱用新人，在城鎮各處執行不同的工作。

新人有一筆預付的雇用花費和一份薪水，代表他們每小時進行任何工作後要支付的祕寶庫金幣。

新人可以專精於一個或以上的工作。每個工作專精都會有階級，決定新人對這項工作的熟練程度。

可以花費金幣請勞爾夫重骰視窗中的新人。

detail: 雇→僱
en:
Mercenaries of Trarthus have arrived in Wraeclast and are searching for worthy Exiles to offer their services to.

When encountering a Mercenary, you will be able to inspect all gear, skills and supports they have equipped. Then, you can choose to duel them for a Gold wager. If you win the duel, you keep your Gold and the Mercenary will follow you as an ally in combat for the next few areas.

In addition, you can select a piece of gear the Mercenary has equipped, or an item from their rucksack. If you win, you get to take it for yourself!

In Map areas, you can also request a rematch from the Mercenary. If you win they drop a Warrant, allowing you to challenge them to a duel in a future Map. Though their skills and supports will remain the same, they will have a different set of items equipped the next time you duel them.

Finally, if you are a Scion with the Luminary Ascendancy you can choose to permanently hire the Mercenary if you win the duel.
zh:
特拉特斯的傭兵已抵達瓦爾克拉斯，並且正在尋找值得提供其服務的流亡者。

遭遇傭兵時，你可以查看他們的所有裝備、技能和輔助寶石。接著，你可以選擇支付金幣賭注與他們進行決鬥。如果你贏得決鬥，你將能保留你的金幣，而該傭兵會在接下來的數個區域內，作為盟友跟隨你一同作戰。

此外，你還可以挑選一件傭兵身上穿戴的裝備，或是他們背包中的一件物品。只要你在決鬥中獲勝，就能將該物品據為己有！

在異界地圖區域內，你還能向傭兵要求重賽。如果你獲勝，他們會掉落一張"契約書"，讓你能在未來的異界地圖中再次向他們發起決鬥挑戰。雖然他們的技能與輔助寶石會保持不變，但下次你與他們決鬥時，他們將會換上一套全新的裝備物品。

最後，如果你是擁有"輝耀使徒"昇華天賦的貴族，只要你在決鬥中獲勝，便可以選擇永久僱用該雇傭兵。

en: H
zh: 雇

en:
"Recommend further production of Prototype #122. It makes
an ideal weapon for our suppression troops and guards."
zh:
“建議進一步生產原型 #122。
是我們鎮壓部隊和後衛的理想武器。"

en:
"Test subject walked right through the poison gas defenses, and attempts to slow her
failed. Suppression troop six, the 'Furious Flagellants,' have been sent to intervene."
zh:
"測試對像走過了毒氣防禦系統，並試圖減緩她的失敗。
已派出了第六支鎮壓部隊，即“狂暴鞭笞＂進行干預。"

en:
"Suppression troop two, the 'Martyrs for Science,' were able to seal
the portals before Outpost Four was overrun. Only three men survived."
zh:
"鎮壓部隊第二，“科學烈士”在第四個哨所被佔領之前
能夠封鎖門戶。只有三人倖存。"

detail: 注→註
en:
For this beauty,
beauty without strength,
chokes out life.
zh:
空有妍麗美貌
奈何無力自保
注定玉殞香消

en:
"Death can be outrun with these, but beware!
In running from death, you may forget to live."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 202
zh:
"用這些可以跑得過死亡，但要小心！
在逃避死亡的過程中，你可能會忘記活著。”
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 202

en: "So close, yet frustratingly distinct. Something more is going on here..."
zh: “如此接近，但令人沮喪的與眾不同。這裡將發生更多事…”

detail: 欲→慾
en:
"It is a cruel joke that 
Man was born with more 
Intent than Life."
- Malachai
zh: 「人生何其殘酷諷刺啊，生年縱有限，欲念無窮盡。」- 瑪拉凱

en:
"Why is Prototype #67 never in the vault it should be?
Either we're keeping faulty logs, or..." 
- Researcher Graven
zh:
"為什麼原型 #67 應該從未出現在金庫中？
我們要麼保留錯誤的日誌，要麼...”
- 研究員格雷文

detail: 注→註
en:
If you do not learn from a won battle
then you have already lost the war.
zh:
光是打贏戰役，而不知從中學習
還是注定一敗塗地。

detail: 愈→癒
en: In sickness, the insane becomes sane.
zh: 常人愈病愈昏瞑，瘋人越病越清醒。

detail: 伙→夥
en: Some people live on the suffering of others.
zh: 有些傢伙就是靠折磨他人維生。

detail: 注→註
en:
With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.
zh:
法杖在手
怒火在心，
靈魂身軀
分離注定。

detail: 愠→慍
en:
Those who are skilled in combat do not become angered.
Those who are skilled at winning do not become afraid. 
Thus the wise win before they fight, 
while the ignorant fight to win.
zh:
爭戰之兵不知愠
常勝之士不知畏
賢者勝之不武
愚者武之求勝

en: "The best place for this prototype would be in the hands of our enemies."
zh: “這個原型的最佳位置將在我們的敵人手中。"

en: "A curious jewel. Like so many others, a shining little paradox."
zh: “一顆奇異的寶石。像其他許多寶石一樣，閃閃發光的小悖論。"

en:
"Even for the great Magi,
time passes without relent."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
zh:
“即使是偉大的賢者，
時間也沒有留情。“
- 女王奇術師多里亞尼

en:
"Cut down the tallest tree,
and another becomes the tallest."
- Old Ezomyte saying
zh:
“砍下最高的樹，
讓另一個成為最高的。“
- 艾茲麥的古老智慧

detail: 家→傢
en:
We swell and flood
and drown the undeserving beneath our might.
zh:
膨脹、汎濫的我們，
力使不值得的家伙溺死。

en:
"There seems to be some innate relationship between the forces of
chaos and cold. Perhaps we should consult an occultist."
zh:
“力量之間似乎存在某種先天的關係
混亂和寒冷。 也許我們應該諮詢神秘學家。"

en:
<size:29>{"Fate was always my nemesis... 
But it didn't stop me then, and it won't stop me now."
- Kjetilbrann, The Undaunted}
zh:
<size:29> {“命運總是我的剋星...
但它那時並沒有阻止我，現在也不會阻止我。“
- 無畏的傑特布蘭恩}

en:
<size:28>{"For all your struggles, all your achievements, even for the greatest of us, a story is all that remains. Write it well." 

-Julius Perandus, Father of Chitus}
zh:
<size:28> {”對於你所有的掙扎，你所有的成就，即使對於我們中最偉大的人來說，所遺留下的就是個故事。好好寫。”

-朱利葉斯普蘭德思，切特斯之父}

en:
<size:26>{"Such dedication for so many years,
all for a couple extra letters at the front of your name..."}
zh:
<size:26> {”這麼多年的奉獻精神，
只需在你的姓名前面加上幾個額外的字...”}

detail: 注→註
en:
<size:24>{Plenty enter, dreaming of treasure
Twenty bled, slain as they fled
Shadows loom, half left doomed
The blind cries, five lost eyes
Careless twins, a lich's new prize
One as a decoy, none pass the king
Gehennix feeds only on whispers}
zh:
<size:24> {大量闖入，夢想著寶藏
二十人流血，逃亡時被殺
陰影交織，注定要剩下一半
盲目哭泣，五人失明
粗心的雙胞胎，巫妖的新獎
一個作為誘餌，沒有一個通過國王
吉漢尼斯只以耳語為食}

en: "It was as though my very thoughts were breaking... fracturing into tiny motes to be lost on the wind."
zh: “就好像我的想法正在破碎....分裂成微小的塵埃，隨風而逝。”

en: "When they realize our true intent, they will decry us, assault us, and try to crush what we have built. We must stand tall, Qotra, and make the future our own."
zh: “當他們意識到我們的真實意圖時，他們會譴責我們，攻擊我們，並試圖摧毀我們所建造的東西。我們必須站起來，卡特拉，讓未來成為我們自己的。”

en: "You seek the power of my strongest potions, but the price will be far higher than you can imagine."
zh: “你尋求我最強魔藥的力量，但代價遠超你的想像。”

en: "So desperate was I for control, I turned my entire world into a prison. Now you will share in my agony."
zh: “我渴望控制，我把我的整個世界變成了監獄。現在你將分擔我的痛苦。”

en: "Virtue gems have facets beyond those that can be seen by the mortal eye. Let us look deeper..."
zh: “美德寶石的刻面超出了肉眼所能看到的範圍。讓我們深入了解一下…”

detail: 注→註
en: The Atlas is our prison, and our only defence. She is our only hope, and our certain doom.
zh: 輿圖是我們的監獄，也是我們唯一的防禦。她是我們唯一的希望，也是我們注定的厄運。

detail: 栗→慄
en:
Slumbering in the breach between worlds,
the Brine King dreamt of a day he would rise,
in triumph from the shivering depths and take
back the Kingdom he once so ruthlessly culled.
zh:
在異界間的裂痕沉睡，
海王夢想著甦醒那天，
從寒栗的深處奪回
曾經無情剔除他的王國。

en:
Records of Arakaali's violent reign suggest she kept her citizens
sedated with 'juices of lust' and venoms of the spider. Perhaps her
guise of seductress was in fact her way of farming those 'juices'.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
zh:
"艾爾卡莉暴力的統治，就像她利用了某種蜘蛛魔液
使她的公民迷幻。誘惑也許只是她生產這些“果汁”的幌子。
-"瓦爾傳說"費歐普羅斯學者，艾米爾

en:
"So it's true." Shakari thought, as she took her final breath.
"My father, Sin, wishes me dead. And he has sent his rabid dog to do it..."
zh:
"是真的。“夏卡莉想著並嚥下了最後一口氣。
“我的父親，罪，希望我死去。而且他派了病犬......“

en:
"Whatever these maps are, it is clear they are dangerous. Send in only
test subjects, no guards or researchers." 
- Administrator Qotra
zh:
“無論這些地圖是什麼，顯然它們都是危險的。僅發送
測試對象，沒有警衛或研究人員。
- 主管卡特拉

en:
"Twelve test subjects were expended in the production of Prototype #800.
Was it worth the expense? Only time will tell."
zh:
“十二個測試目標可以製作一個原型 #800。
值得花這筆錢嗎？ 只有時間證明一切。"

en:
"Better... stronger... more vital... and then... failure. Always, failure.
What key fundamental secret are we missing?"
zh:
“更好...更強...更重要...然後...失敗。總是失敗。
我們缺少什麼關鍵的基礎秘密？"

detail: 注→註
en:
Destined for sacrifice,
they were dressed in garments
that blurred the lines between this world
and the next.
zh:
注定要犧牲，
他們穿著衣裳
這模糊了這世和來世的
界線。

en:
"Lord of Bone, Lord of Flesh, yet all that we can
master turns to ash." 
- Researcher Arn
zh:
“骨肉之主，肉體之主，但我們所能
將主人變成灰燼。"
- 研究員昂恩

en:
"One coy look. One blown kiss. One word spoken.
One night I wish I'd forget."
zh:
”一個靦腆的樣子。一個飛吻。一個被說出的字。
一個我希望遺忘的夜晚。“

en:
"The Midnight Tinkerer's aid was invaluable during our brief alliance,
but when we failed to make any progress on resurrection, he continued his search elsewhere..."
zh:
“午夜匠師的協助在我們短暫的同盟中非常寶貴，
但是當我們在復活方面沒有取得任何進展時，他繼續在其他地方搜尋...“

detail: 愈→癒
en:
Mortal pleasures can hold back the memories,
but a hollow soul can never be healed.
zh:
凡人的享樂可以擋住回憶，
但空洞的靈魂永遠無法治愈。

en:
How simple a power, on which empires turn,
when one man stands firm and says, "I refuse."
zh:
多麼簡單的力量，帝國依靠它，
當一個人堅定地說：“我拒絕＂。

en: "They ascended together, one unwillingly. The vilified became black as coal, and the lauded, golden. After a lifetime of ambition, he finally had his heart's desire. It only cost him his brother." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “二人同登，一人不甘。罵者黑如炭，讚者得金。畢生雄心，終得心願，只是犧牲他的兄弟。” - 異教徒．利希亞

en: "He took the newcomers' symbol and made it his own. Finally, they flocked to him. Finally, he had the power and wealth he so desired." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “他拿了新人的標誌，把它變成了自己的標誌。最後，他們蜂擁而至。他終於得到了他想要的權力和財富。” - 異教徒．利希亞

en: "He took many of his people's traditions and gilded them, hollowed them. They rejected his new religion, and he and his followers were forced to depart the mountains for lands unknown." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “他吸收了他人民的許多傳統，將它們鍍金、掏空。他們拒絕了他的新宗教，他和他的追隨者被迫離開山區，前往未知的土地。” - 異教徒．利希亞

en: "The newcomers were terrified of fire. He used their fear to control them, to lay the seeds of unquestioning faith. He claimed only his god could protect them." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “新來的害怕火。他用他們的恐懼來控制他們，播下堅定信念的種子。他宣稱只有他的神才能保護他們。” - 異教徒．利希亞

en: "In pursuit of divinity, he tried many times to found a religion. Few followed his initial symbols and proverbs. He needed something greater. A symbol none could deny." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “為了追求神性，他多次嘗試建立宗教。很少有人追隨他最初的象徵和諺語。他需要更偉大的東西。一個無人能否認的象徵。” - 異教徒．利希亞

en: "His followers were too small in number to spark divinity, so he turned to a greater power: hatred. He vilified his brother, sparking zealotry, and the change finally began." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “他的追隨者人數太少，無法激發神性，所以他轉向了更大的力量：仇恨。他詆毀他的兄弟，野火燎原，改變終於開始。” - 異教徒．利希亞

en: "It's all here. The lie at the core of my faith. Maxarius was not the first chosen of Innocence. Maxarius was Innocence himself. A charlatan, a liar, and a power-seeker." - Lycia, the Heretic
zh: “都在這裡。謊言是我信仰的核心。馬克薩留斯不是第一個被選中的純真者。馬克薩留斯就是純真者本人。一個江湖騙子、騙徒和一個權力追求者。” - 異教徒．利希亞

detail: 癡→痴
en:
They came for enlightenment,
but were imprisoned by madness.
zh:
他們尋求啟示而來，
最後卻受癡迷與瘋狂監禁。

en:
"Did nobody think to report that we had acquired some sort of free-floating
Memory? Cease testing and lock this away immediately!" 
- Administrator Qotra
zh:
“沒有人想到報告我們已經獲得了某種自由浮動
記憶？ 停止測試並立即將其鎖定！"
- 主管卡特拉

en:
"Recommend extreme caution on any prototypes that can lead to a chain reaction
of deaths. Lab Twelve has been lost to the flames." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
zh:
“對於任何可能導致連鎖反應的原型，建議格外小心
死亡。 實驗室12已經失火了。"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en:
"Researchers will refrain from scaring each other by firing ice spears while holding
Prototype #141. Sooner or later, someone's going to lose an eye." 
- Administrator Qotra
zh:
“研究人員將避免在手持時發射冰矛來互相驚嚇
原型 #141。 遲早有人會因此失明。"
- 主管卡特拉

en:
"For personal defence, Prototype #444 is fantastic. It is one hundred percent
effective seventy five percent of the time... once." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
zh:
“對於個人防禦，原型 #444 太棒了。它是100% 
效率、75%時間…一次。"
- 首席研究員卡薩雷特

en:
"I believed I understood Prototype #112 quite fully, until a test subject
with Azmeri ancestry donned it. I will be haunted by the results
for the rest of my life."  - Researcher Graven
zh:
“我相信我完全理解原型 #112，直到擁有阿茲莫里血統的
測試對象將其戴上為止。我一生的結果
都會困擾我。" - 研究員格雷文

en:
"This will help with the pain.
One for you... and one for me."
- Doctor 'Shaky Hands' Opden
zh:
“這將有助於減輕痛苦。
一個給你...一個給我。"
- 「抖不停」歐普登

detail: 注→註
en: All roads lead to that destined doom.
zh: 條條大路通向那注定的厄運。

en:
"A symbol of my birthright and claim to my fiefdom. 
I must have it if I am to return my family to its rightful place."
zh:
“象徵我與生俱來的權利，並宣稱擁有我的領地。
如果我要讓家人回到其應有的地位，我必須擁有它。"

en:
"A true curiosity. Matches no known language, yet its illustrations hint at knowledge 
only rediscovered hundreds of years after the death of its unknown author."
zh:
“真正的好奇心。任何語言都無法符合，但其暗示了知識
直到其不知名的作者去世數百年後才重新被發現。"

en:
"Balabus Arimor was a little-known preacher during the days of Emperor Chitus,
who believed eternal life could be achieved through ritual sacrifice.
We shall see whether he was a prophet - or a charlatan."
zh:
“ 巴拉巴斯阿里摩爾在切特斯帝國時代是一位鮮為人知的傳教士，
相信永生可以通過祭祀來實現。
我們將看看他是先知還是騙子。"

en:
"As warm as living flesh, and smelling strongly of sulphite.
Morbid curiosity compels me to add it to my collection of oddities."
zh:
“像活的肉一樣溫暖，並強烈地聞到硫酸。
病態的好奇心迫使我將其添加到我的奇特收藏中。"

en:
"I'll give it to her and tell her
'It once held the reflection of a Queen, and now it will once more.'
Anton can cross the Vastiri on his family fruits 
if he thinks he loves her like I do."
zh:
我會把它給她，然後告訴她：
“曾經有女王的倒影，現在又會了。”
安東可以靠他的家庭水果渡過瓦斯提里
如果他認為自己像我一樣愛她。

en:
"If we can prove Jamanra existed, then the Faridun may have a chance to rejoin the
Maraketh. I, for one, would like to meet my parents. I have many questions..."
zh:
“如果我們可以證明賈嫚拉的存在，那麼法里登也許有機會重新加入
馬拉克斯我想與我的父母見面。 我有很多問題...“

en:
"There is nothing quite so exquisite as a forced confession. The sufferer will
say anything to make the pain stop, and that's the point. Guilt is irrelevant."
zh:
“沒有什麼比強迫認罪更加精緻了。
說出什麼來止痛，這就是重點。 內疚則無關緊要。"

en:
"It supposedly causes enormous plants to grow from almost any soil. The myth claims we
need to sacrifice a baby to make it function, but that's a bit grotesque, even for me."
zh:
“據推測，這使巨大的植物幾乎可以在任何土壤中生長。
需要犧牲一個嬰兒才能使其正常運轉，但這對我來說還是有點怪誕的。"

en:
"When hope was but a memory, the twin sister Sekhemas Solerai and Lundara arose to unite the Maraketh.
They wielded the essence of gold and silver. The Spear is one of the two weapons that forged us."
zh:
“當希望不過是記憶的時候，雙胞胎姊妹絲克瑪索拉萊和倫達拉站起來團結了馬拉克斯。
他們運用了黃金和白銀的精髓。 矛是鍛造我們的兩把武器之一。"

en:
"Wraeclast is harsh, and the Plains of Vastiri are unforgiving. We Maraketh can
ill afford an internal war. We must prove that Nashta is behind these attacks."
zh:
“ 瓦爾克拉斯很殘酷，瓦斯提里平原也不能原諒。我們馬拉克斯可以

I forget what it was, but I'm sure I'll remember by the time we need to get it.
Was it beetles? Bottles? I think it began with 'B'.
Or it had no 'B'."

detail: 雇→僱
en:
In <italic>{Path of Exile: Heist}, you will hire skilled thieves to help you pull off risky Heists. Steal valuable artifacts to fund and train your crew as you plan towards the execution of a Grand Heist.

Our September expansion contains the Heist challenge league, nine new Skills and Support Gems, revamps of Curses, Steel Skills, and some Spells. Grand Heists offer exclusive new rewards such as Weapon and Body Armour Enchantments, Heist Trinkets, Alternate-quality Gems and Replica Unique Items.
zh:
在<italic>{流亡黯道：劫盜同盟}中，你將雇用技術高超的盜賊來幫你完成危險的劫盜任務。當你執行劫盜之星計畫時，盜取有價值的工藝品來資助和培訓你的隊員。

我們 9 月的大改版包含劫盜挑戰聯盟、9 個新技能和補助寶石、詛咒、鋼之技能和部分法術翻新。劫盜之星會給予專屬獎勵，像是武器、胸甲附魔、劫盜飾品、替代品質寶石和複製傳奇道具。

detail: 雇→僱
en: In order to execute a Heist, you need to know the location of a valuable Artifact and what defences safeguard it. Contracts containing these clues can be found throughout Wraeclast alongside coins with the mysterious emblem of the Rogue Harbour. Travel there and turn in these objects to hire the expertise you need for your Heist.
zh: 為了執行劫盜，你必須知道哪裡有價值連城的工藝品和了解它的防禦措施。包含這些線索的合約和有著盜賊港灣神秘輝印的金幣，都可以在瓦爾克拉斯找到。前往那裡並上交這些物品，以為你的劫盜任務雇用所需的專業人士。

detail: 雇→僱
en: The ultimate goal of a thief is to pull off a Grand Heist. This requires access to Blueprints that show where the vaults are located inside sprawling facilities. These elaborate jobs require masterful planning, purchasing additional intel about the facility, and hiring multiple Rogues to assist with their many obstacles. This planning can result in a huge pay-off as each vault has its own exclusive rewards.
zh: 盜賊的終極目標就是達成劫盜之星。但需要取得「藍圖」來確認寶庫在這龐大設施內的所在位置。這些繁瑣的工作需要大師級的規劃、購買設施內的額外資訊和雇用盜賊們來協助處理障礙。此計畫可以帶來巨額的報酬，每個寶庫都有專屬的獎勵。

detail: 雇→僱 雇→僱 雇→僱 雇→僱
en: Theopolis wasn't built in a day, and neither will Kingsmarch, but many hands make light work. Head to the town and hire skilled workers who will aid you in mining, smelting, disenchanting, farming and other jobs needed in Kingsmarch. You'll notice each person has their specialties, and a wage cost. It'll be up to you to hire and fire as you please. Over the course of the league you'll be searching for your perfect employees for each job. Once you have them, you'll have to keep them paid, safe, and alive.
zh: 費歐普羅斯不是一天造成的，金司馬區也不例外。但只要有足夠人手，建造的過程就會縮短許多。玩家可前往城鎮雇用協助你開採、冶煉、破幻、耕種等其他金司馬區必要工作的工人。你會發現，每個工人都有各自的專精和工資成本，而雇用和解雇的事就由你來決定。在整個聯盟的遊戲過程中，你將要尋找最適合各個工作的工人。雇用他們之後，你就得支付他們薪資，並保護他們的安危。

detail: 雇→僱
en: Aside from shipping, the Kalguurans are big on their technology. They have hired Isla, an engineer from the Heist League. Once at Endgame, Isla can help you build a series of Kalguuran-modified Map Devices which you can put a queue of Maps into. If you've hired a few skilled combatants, they will put themselves to work running those maps for you one after another.
zh: 除了運輸之外，卡爾葛人的科技也很厲害。他們雇用了來自劫盜聯盟的伊絲菈。在遊戲的終局階段，伊絲菈可以幫你打造一系列卡爾葛人改良過的地圖裝置，讓你可以添加到一系列地圖當中。如果你招募了一些實力不錯的鬥士，他們就會自行一張又一張地幫你跑圖。

detail: 雇→僱
en:
Upon meeting a Mercenary, as per Trarthan tradition, they will challenge you to a duel to test your strength.

Before beginning the duel, you will be offered an overview of the Mercenary you've encountered. You can then decide to duel them, choosing a reward for your victory: you can hire their services, take one of their items, or exile them.
zh:
遭遇傭兵時，他們會按特拉特斯傳統，向你發出決鬥挑戰來測試你的力量。

開始決鬥前，你可以查看遭遇的傭兵。接著你可以決定與他們決鬥，並選擇你獲勝時的獎勵：雇用他們來為你效力、從他們身上取得一個物品，或是流放他們。

detail: 雇→僱 雇→僱
en:
In Curse of the Allflame, the Scion is getting a new Ascendancy class, the Luminary.

Upon becoming a Luminary, you can permanently hire a Mercenary as an active ally in combat. Unlike regular Mercenaries, Luminary's hired Mercenaries can have their equipment changed, unlocking countless new build possibilities.
zh:
在《亡焰咒海》中，貴族獲得了一個全新的昇華職業——輝耀使徒。

成為輝耀使徒後，你可以永久雇用一名傭兵作為戰鬥中的常駐盟友。與一般傭兵不同，輝耀使徒所雇用的傭兵可以更換裝備，從而解鎖無數全新的流派可能性。
